method: Per-epic Sonnet reviewers against six prototype maps, each review re-checked by an adversarial Sonnet verifier; plus a verified data-model delta and a verified reverse check.

themes.title: Contract-centred billing model
themes.description: Billing route, Type 1/2/3 and protected default Type 1s replaced by holders, dated Contract versions, standalone lines, one No contract (RVG), mandatory Contract per Procedure, staged review, authorisation snapshot. XL, split into model, versioning screens, picker.

themes.title: Pricing, units and modifiers
themes.description: Price, rate and discount held on the Procedure with no reason, Contract flag gating anaesthetist, no-charge invoice, modifier split above four, RVG hidden-key master, modifier records with explanations, age pre-applied, out-of-range warns, completion rules reworked. XL.

themes.title: Hospital intake matching screen
themes.description: No review-and-merge screen exists; HL7/FHIR and PDF rows auto-apply. Need staged rows, match/create/Draft List/reject, per-row change type, differences for approval, unmatched queue, day move as cancel plus new, edits until AUTHORISED. XL.

themes.title: NHI mandatory and text as received
themes.description: Remove provisional patients and NHI pending; waiting-for-NHI queue; procedure text kept per source with time; separate invoice description. M, bundled with intake.

themes.title: Prepayment and holding account
themes.description: Prepaid Contract triggers prepayment at line price, admin approval with letter, payable to holding account, second pair at authorise, refund on cancel, no automatic balance. Anaesthetist currently paid before the procedure. XL.

themes.title: Events, additional invoices and credit notes
themes.description: Post-op addendum Booking replaced by events on the Procedure, free-form additional invoices, credit then rebill, negative payables netted in a weekly payment cycle. XL.

themes.title: Edit window until AUTHORISED and anaesthetist views
themes.description: Anaesthetist edits stay open on SUBMITTED, List leaves main view at AUTHORISED, balances show invoices immediately, search and scroll-back. M.

themes.title: OQ-81 reversal: unavailability is never a conflict
themes.description: Remove availability conflict kind, make closed sessions non-assignable by the office, route sickness through return-or-assign to a Draft List. M to L, independent.

themes.title: Single-Booking move and notification pool
themes.description: Anaesthetist moves one Booking into a new List in a colleague's free Slot; pool notices gain resolve tick, count, show-resolved and an ask-the-office source. M.

themes.title: Payer, insurer, balances and warnings
themes.description: Payer name and email on the Booking, insurer and approval number on the Booking, patient balance alerts, remaining warning rules, ledger positions, split as a Booking action. L, after Contract rework.

themes.title: Profile, reporting and admin polish
themes.description: Drop GST period, add bank details, monthly GST of payments passed on, flat owed list, preferred pairing ordering, audit exclusions, cutover load, master calendar, simulated sign-in, scale and privacy demos, point-of-need help. M, mostly small.

epics.title: Schedule canvas, Slots and Lists
epics.observations:
EP-01's four in-scope items reduce to one cause. Public is not an availability status, and the validator (slotStatus.ts kindClash, :218-219) actively refuses the label "Public" because the prototype treats it as a List kind only. US-01.3.5 and US-01.3.6 hold up under adversarial re-checking.

Work needed for the Public gap:
- Seed: add a Public status to SEED_SLOT_STATUSES (bookable false, anaesthetistCanSet true, colour Unavailable's or its own). Its key must NOT be 'public', because DisplayKey = ListKind | SlotStatusKey is one key space and resolveDisplayStatus resolves List kinds first.
- Validator: relax kindClash and its tests.
- Footnote: reword the AvailabilityStatusesView footnote.
- Persist version: bump PERSIST_VERSION (currently 50).
- Decision: how the List kind 'public' (chip "Public") coexists with a Public availability label. Both would show "Public" in the StatusLegend.
- Demo data: seed a few Public sessions with the note "CPH" so the criteria can be shown. Check the free-session counts quoted in demo-guide beats (S2 Beat 1b and any "N free sessions" figures) before adding them.
- Reuse: US-01.5.2 and US-01.5.3 ranges and series reuse the master and pick Public up automatically. US-13.1.1 (day view text) is related.

Size: M for US-01.2.1, S for US-01.2.2 (same change; do them together).

epics.title: Booking intake and change handling
epics.observations:
The matching screen (US-02.1.2 and its children, outside these four items) is the keystone. Every hospital-side gap in FT-02.1 and US-02.1.1 closes only when it exists. Today the feed in the Integrations monitor auto-applies messages (interim code marked 'until Phase 33'), and DraftOrigin 'hospitalRow' is defined but nothing creates it. Moving hospital rows behind the screen turns the Messages tab from an applying log into a producer of rows. The 'Hospital feed changes the primary' trigger (feed-changes-primary) is documented as applying directly until then. The Integrations Future-scope badges on Messages and Feed config also need rethinking, since the hospital import is in scope as a row source.

Dependencies: build US-02.2.4 (List origin and sender address) before US-02.3.3, whose To-address rule reads it. US-02.3.3 also relies on the change history (US-02.5.5), Hospital.contactEmail (exists), surgeon office contacts (US-13.6.5, exist) and the List-move notification (US-13.8.2, exists). The older surgeon-room email helpers (roomEmailForSurgeon, otherRoomsForSurgeon, guarded by roomContactsGuard.test.ts) are superseded by the 18 November ruling (List sender, else first office contact) and need revisiting, including that guard test. OQ-13 (hospital format) and OQ-124 (whether emailed Lists stop) are open but do not block building the screen or the email draft. A new List field means PERSIST_VERSION must be bumped when US-02.2.4 is built.

Grading note: FT-02.1 and US-02.1.1 are both marked Contradicts because the direct-apply feed is the replaced reading; US-02.1.1 is the more arguable of the two (Partial is defensible).

Demo script impact: S1 (around line 140 of docs/demo-guide/03-demo-script.md) fires 'S12 · New booking · MSG-STG-1001' and the Booking appears straight away on Dr Souter's List. Once hospital rows go behind the matching screen that beat needs an office review and accept step. The S1 aside on the Tue 4 Aug 09:30 'right total knee' Booking and the S2 optional 'hospital's wording arrives' aside (around line 343) rely on direct application and would change. The S2 List-move notification beats (around lines 424 to 468) would gain a 'Draft update email' step with US-02.3.3. The surgeon PDF ingest beat would need the sender address shown or typed at upload.

epics.title: Booking and Procedure capture (anaesthetist)
epics.observations: EP-03 slice (6 items): US-03.2.1, US-03.3.1, US-03.3.4 and US-03.3.8 Match (all upheld on re-check, including the Agreed US-03.2.1); FT-03.7 and US-03.7.1 Contradict (upheld). The capture side (primary Procedure, RVG type-ahead, ranged base units, itemised modifiers, age modifier) was rebuilt in catch-up phases 19 to 24 and is current. The only structural gap is events (phases 38b and 39b): there is no event entity, only the interim addendum Booking. Closing it removes addPostOpAddendum, Booking.bookingType 'postOpAddendum' and addendumOfBookingId, the addendum banner in BookingDetailBody, the interim BillingLinesCard, and the related audit labels, and needs a PERSIST_VERSION bump. Note the billing run is event-driven on List authorise (wireBillingRun), with no user-triggered 'run' control, so next-run billing of events needs a new demo button on the Admin Billing monitor. Dependencies: US-03.7.2 and US-03.7.3 (bill an event, see a Procedure's events), EP-08 (bundling by billable party, additional invoices US-08.6.3, credits as events US-08.6.5), FT-11.2 billable party, US-05.5.2 (ACC pre-op events, OQ-12 parked), US-03.1.6 (past Procedures are read-only seeded history on backdrop Lists, so events on them need new reach), US-07.3.2 (events off Lists). OQ-12 and OQ-138 do not block the generic event; OQ-132 is open for US-03.2.1 and the prototype's provisional reading (base units stay on the marked primary, none billed when it is fixed priced) matches the story as written. Residual small points, not gaps: the US-03.3.4 prose says an included modifier 'cannot be unselected' while its criteria say none is locked (prototype follows the criteria); a fixed-price primary on a mixed multi-procedure Booking still shows a Modifiers section (consistent with US-05.3.1); the Admin Modifiers 'Provisional' badge is defensible since OQ-95 is still to confirm with Vanessa. Demo guide: S4 Beat 2 'post-op addendum' (docs/demo-guide/03-demo-script.md, 02-workflows-and-handoffs.md, 04-presenter-cheat-sheet.md, README.md), the DemoControlPanel S4 blurb and recipe, and the 'stage-post-op' trigger text would be rewritten around 'add an event on a Procedure, then run the next billing run'; no other scripted beat is affected.

epics.title: Contracts
epics.observations: EP-04 is largely built: the flat Contract model (Phases 18 to 25) matches nine of the eleven in-scope stories on re-verification. Two stories carry gaps, both from the 18 November decisions (OQ-133, OQ-135, taken by Donald for the build, not yet discussed with AA), which reverse the prototype's earlier readings D79 (no list of affected Procedures) and D81 (a Disabled Contract bills as normal and raises no flag). (1) US-04.1.2 Contradicts, size M: a dated-change warning that lists Procedures dated on or after the change still on the old Contract (needs a 'replaces Contract' and change-date input when creating), a matching warning when disabling a Contract, and a new review-flag rule for an un-authorised Procedure dated on or after the day its Contract was disabled (the day comes from the contract.disable audit row). The editor's own text and three demo-guide files (03-demo-script.md:568, 04-presenter-cheat-sheet.md:185, 02-workflows-and-handoffs.md:419) state the retired behaviour. (2) US-04.2.15 Partial, size S: after adding a price range, warn how many authorised Procedures kept their old price and list them. Correction to the first review: the seed already has an AUTHORISED, invoiced Face lift (Thu 16 Jul, $3,100) inside the existing 'Demo: add a backdated price range' window, so no seed change or PERSIST_VERSION bump is needed and the existing trigger demonstrates the warning. The 04.1.2 demo also needs no new seed: the unedited Mon 10 Aug Face lift Booking is un-authorised and later than the demo clock's 21 Jul. Dependencies: the new flag reuses the review-flag machinery (US-07.2.2) and the lock; US-04.2.14's prepayment lifecycle is interim (US-06.2.2, phase 27); US-04.3.2 search is scoped inside the rail path (US-04.3.8). OQ-114, OQ-122 and OQ-142 are all unresolved and the prototype is consistent with the text as written. Retired-model screenshots cited by the stories need recapture after the build, not a prototype gap.

epics.title: RVG master data and fee calculation rules
epics.observations: EP-05 is largely built (catch-up phases 19, 19a, 19b, 23, 24 cover the RVG masters, the modifier master, the price ladder and the multi-procedure rule). I re-verified FT-05.2, US-05.1.5, US-05.2.5 and US-05.3.1 against the code and the text as written, with no gaps found. One real gap: US-05.5.2, which is Contradicts rather than only Partial. The prototype still models the ACC pre-op as the superseded BillingLine stand-in. That line rolls into the Procedure's price, and a typed, prepaid or authorised price silently drops it. Its caption also hardcodes CS250/CS260/CS70 as a settled code set although OQ-12 is open. It depends wholly on the pre-op/post-op event model (FT-03.7, US-03.7.1, OQ-121; phases 38b and 39b, where 39b already lists US-05.5.2), so close it there: keep the ACC codes as preconfigured-event data, not copy, and retire BillingLine, AddBillingLineSheet and the fee.ts add-on path together. OQ-132 (base units on a mixed Booking with a fixed or open primary) is handled by the provisional option 1 in baseOn(), and a seeded mixed Booking already exists (seed/bookings.ts:717), so a different answer changes baseOn(), its tests and the UnitsCard caption only. OQ-95 age bands (answered 18 Nov as the recommendation) are implemented as written, but the Modifiers tab still carries a 'Provisional' badge, which is acceptable until Vanessa confirms. Small unspecified edges are logged in code as our reading: with a fixed primary and modifiers of 4 or fewer they are billed nowhere, and above 4 the remainder goes to the first RVG participant. The mixed-Booking fixed primary still shows the Booking's modifiers section, which is needed for US-05.3.1 but is the only place a fixed price asks for modifiers. Demo beats S3 (multi-procedure) and S5 (ASA III modifier) are unaffected. Moving the ACC pre-op to an event will change docs/demo-guide/04-presenter-cheat-sheet.md (the billing-line section) and 02-workflows-and-handoffs.md, but no S1 to S5 beat uses it.

epics.title: Prepayment
epics.observations: Phase 27 (the prepayment lifecycle) is the planned rebuild, and the code is full of 'INTERIM until Phase 27' markers. These are the pieces it replaces: prepaymentDetail full/split, the PREPAYMENT_DEDUCTION netting line, procedureRequiresPrepayment, and the office-only raisePreProcedureInvoice with send:true. The AA Holding account is one shared new creditor that drives FT-06.5, US-06.3.1, US-06.4.1 and US-06.5.1 together, so the four L sizes overlap heavily: building the creditor, the pair re-pointing and the AUTHORISE transfer once closes most of them. Structural dependencies outside this set: EP-08 (US-08.2.2 final invoice leaves prepaid Procedures off, US-08.3.1 linked receivable and payable, US-08.6.3 and US-08.6.5 manual additional invoice and credit note), EP-09 (Xero creditor pair and transfer), US-06.5.2 and US-06.3.7 (cancel or Contract change after sent or paid: credit or full refund from holding; cancelBooking currently ignores billing), US-06.5.4 and US-06.3.6 (letter, OQ-120), and US-13.7.4 (approval on/off setting, no admin screen yet). Parts that already match and should be kept: per-payer prepayment invoices and the payer lock (22a), the derived requirement and unpaid warning that never blocks (15a), the read-only prepaid price after raise (A16), prepaid Contracts refused RVG pricing and so any override, and a move that re-triggers nothing. Open questions: OQ-125 (release trigger; use AUTHORISE, flagged), OQ-73 (already coded to the written reading), OQ-120, OQ-140. Demo guide: S4 Beat 1 (prepayment warning, Dr Souter Fri 24 Jul AM, Annette Riley) stays valid but gains approval and holding-account beats; the line about a move not recalculating the prepayment stays true. The seeded PAID prepayment case (seed/billing.ts, scenario.prepaymentPaid) and the Souter prepaid Booking need their pair re-pointed to the holding account, and PERSIST_VERSION bumped when the seed changes. S1 to S3 do not touch prepayment. Verification found all seven gradings sound; the only change was to US-06.3.2's demo_trigger (a partial-payment demo already exists) and extra evidence on cancelBooking.

epics.title: List approval workflow
epics.observations: Only US-07.2.2 was in scope. The review screen is largely aligned (Phases 21a, 22a, 24, 25 landed). The flag rules are one pure list, flags never block, and the only authorise blocker is needsPrice. The one gap is the OQ-135 answer of 18 Nov: flag a Disabled Contract on Procedures dated on or after its disable day, never block. Per the answer the date comes from the contract.disable audit entry, since a Contract has no dates of its own. Closing it needs these changes. (1) Pass the disable dates, derived from the audit, into the review-flag input. (2) Add one REVIEW_FLAG_RULES rule, or extend contractNoLongerFits to a date-aware status test. The story notes say it is the same check as 'not offered on the List'. (3) Seed a disabled Contract with its audit entry and a post-disable Booking on a reviewable List, with a PERSIST_VERSION bump. (4) Update the D81 comments and the disableContract docstring. The rail's own candidate test uses status only, which is unaffected. No scripted S1 to S5 beat should break, but a seeded disabled Contract on a reviewable List would change Review flag counts, so the Flags StatTile beats need a re-check. The story is status Verify. The insurer and child-payer text (OQ-140) was confirmed by Donald on 18 Nov but not yet discussed with AA, and OQ-135 is likewise not yet discussed with AA, so wording could still move.

epics.title: Billing/Invoice Engine and internal ledger
epics.observations:
EP-08 is largely built through catch-up phases 22, 22a and 25: the authorise-time lock is the sole source for the billing run (US-08.1.1), invoices group one per payer by identity (US-08.2.1), the split with 'another person' works (US-08.2.3), and delivery and the supplier/agent presentation exist (US-08.4.2, 08.4.5). The verifier corrected one item: US-08.4.1 is Partial, because the holder reference code prints once per invoice from the first Contract (lock.ts ownCharge) instead of against each Procedure's line, so a holder invoice spanning Contracts with different codes loses some (S fix: carry the reference on the locked charge and print it per line).

Two clusters of real gaps remain. (1) Prepaid netting (US-08.2.2, Contradicts): lock.ts still nets prepayments with a deduction line, drops a $0 netted group, and rejects splits and payer changes on prepaid Procedures, all marked INTERIM until Phase 27. Closing it belongs with Phase 27 and 27a (the prepaid amount as the price, the AA Holding transfer paying the anaesthetist, US-06.2.x and 06.3.x) and touches 15 non-test files, the seeded prepaid Bookings and PERSIST_VERSION. (2) Credit note and re-issue (US-08.6.2, US-08.6.5, Missing): nothing exists beyond hint strings. It depends on the ledger (36), Xero mirror (37), additional invoices and Procedure events (38b, FT-03.7), the credit itself (39) and payment runs and remittance (39a, US-10.2.5). It overlaps with US-06.5.2 (cancelled prepayment refund) and US-13.5.2 (audit). Build 38b before 39.

Demo-script impact: S4 Beat 1 (prepaid Booking and its balance-invoice wording) changes when prepaid Procedures leave the final invoice; S3 and S5 (Brian Holt's invoice AA-2026-0007, 'Regenerate from locked data') must stay unchanged; a credit and rebill beat needs adding (S4 exceptions or S3 Beat 3) with a demo-guide update. Matches items carry only Notes-level caveats (OQ-140, OQ-29, OQ-142), not prototype behaviour gaps.

epics.title: Xero integration
epics.observations: EP-09 is graded here for one story only. US-09.1.4 is Proposed and its core questions (granularity of one per procedure, payment or payment run; same record as the ACCPAY; IRD's current name; required wording) all sit in OQ-29. The prototype fixes a provisional reading: one buyer-created tax invoice per receivable, held as the ACCPAY itself, same value, with a single-constant document name (BCTI_DOCUMENT_NAME) and the OQ-29 pill and caption. If the accountant's answer is one per payment or per weekly payment run (Greg, 28 October), the per-invoice model would change. That means the ACCPAY-to-BCTI relation in the XeroAccPay type and handoff, the BCTI count rule in domain/billing/bcti.ts (BCTI_COUNT_RULE, tied to OQ-60 and the AA fee), and the DemoXero card. A re-wording or rename alone is S because the wording is centralised in invoicePresentation.ts. Related dependencies: US-08.4.5 (agent statement, same pill), EP-10 AA fee, and the weekly payment cycle and remittance design. No scripted demo beats are affected; the ACCPAY card in the Xero simulator is where it shows.

epics.title: Payments, disbursement and AA fees
epics.observations: EP-10 (this set) is mostly built (catch-up Phase 16). Authorise-on-payment (US-10.2.1) and the AA fee settings (US-10.3.3) match; the fee run (FT-10.3) matches. Three gaps remain. (1) FT-10.2 Contradicts: the in-app 'Run payables' button on Admin Billing monitor and the 'Settle invoice' payout on the Xero pair page make the anaesthetist payment from the system, where OQ-111 (answered 4 Nov) says Xero's payables run pays and the system only detects and records it (US-09.2.4); ROADMAP D53 and Phase 37 already plan the move, with an Admin read-only list of payables awaiting Xero's run. (2) US-10.2.6 Partial: no payment period or approve-for-payment step; it overlaps US-10.2.7 (weekly ISO-week cycle, Proposed, OQ-47 open; ROADMAP assigns Phase 39a), so build them together. (3) US-10.3.1 corrected to Partial: the story says each fee invoice is tracked in the ledger; no internal ledger exists until Phase 36, which plans an aaFee pair, so the fee leg should be in Phase 36's brief. Open questions OQ-47, OQ-60 and OQ-112 do not change current behaviour: the paid-only BCTI count sits behind one switch (BCTI_COUNT_RULE) while the feature body says 'issued', and month end vs the 20th is not represented. Demo-guide impact: the beat at docs/demo-guide/03-demo-script.md (about lines 762 and 895-905) walks 'Billing monitor, Run payables' then 'Payment received · full' then 'Run payables' again; moving the payout to the Xero simulator changes that beat's button location and wording, and the Control Panel note at DemoControlPanel.tsx:488. Fee beats are unaffected unless OQ-112 moves the run to the 20th. Dependencies: Phase 36 ledger, Phase 37 Xero payables run, US-09.2.4 detect disbursement, US-05.2.7 GST presentation on the fee.

epics.title: Patients and billable parties
epics.observations: Built and correct: the payer-per-Procedure cluster (US-11.2.1 to 11.2.4) and insurer or funder plus approval number (US-11.4.3, apart from the matching-screen display) were built by Phases 21 and 22a and read as correct against the current text. Gaps are NHI and balance related. (1) NHI is not mandatory in the prototype: upsertPatient (store/intake.ts:98-128) still creates a provisional no-NHI Patient, ManualBookingForm and ingestPdfRow accept a blank NHI, a provisional Booking is seeded, and Booking, Review and the web List render 'NHI pending'. That contradicts US-11.1.5 and the epic summary's 'mandatory NHI, no blank'. It also affects US-11.1.4 and US-11.1.1, graded elsewhere. Closing it needs Phase 33 (unmatched queue, Matching screen), Phase 33a (List stubs, US-02.6.1 to 02.6.3) and Phase 40, plus a held chase address: the List's sender, else the surgeon's first office contact (US-13.6.5, OQ-127), one address only. The feeds carry neither. (2) US-11.3.2 needs a new FT-13.7 warning rule (WarningRuleId, patient balance and invoice-age facts from the billing mirror, fixed 90-day threshold, credit balance, evaluated on Booking create or match, beside the prepayment alert). The only trace today is the Billing monitor's 'Prior balance' pill, and a credit-balance concept does not exist in the mirror. The epic's 'admins see a patient's balances across all anaesthetists' belongs to US-11.3.1 (no patient record or master view exists). The unmatched queue and matching screen are the single dependency behind US-11.1.5 and US-11.4.3. Corrections from verification: EP-11 and FT-11.2 are Grouping (summaries with no ACs; their gaps sit in children); US-11.2.2 downgraded to Partial/S for stale 'Booking's Payer row' copy and a Booking-level Payer block on the add-Booking form (ManualBookingForm.tsx:311-329); US-11.4.3 downgraded to Partial/S for the matching-screen display. Open questions: OQ-114 (non-email, non-post delivery) and OQ-122 (posted invoices) leave the prototype on the default email or post with 'To post' labelled provisional; OQ-142 (approval number on the holder's invoice) is not modelled; OQ-140 is settled for the build and carries one provisional label on the payer offer. Demo guide impact: S1 and the 'add a Booking manually, try both NHI formats' beat change when NHI becomes mandatory; S1's Sarah Mitchell repeat-patient beat and the S4 Sarah Mitchell beat are where a balance alert would first appear; the payer beats (S3 split, S4 prepayment, Grace Park guardian) are unaffected.

epics.title: Anaesthetist profile and reporting
epics.observations: Only FT-12.2 and US-12.2.1 were graded (siblings US-12.2.2/3 and FT-12.1 are other agents' items). Main structural change: the ageing concept (AgingBuckets, bucketForAgingDays, receivablesAgingFor, dashboard Receivables aging panel, web 'Overdue' sub-tab and /web/accounts/overdue route, 'n accounts over 60 days' link) must be removed or reduced to a plain flat outstanding list; dashboard tests (store/dashboard.test.ts, lookbackHistory.test.ts) and the catalogue component recreations (apps/demo/catalogue/mobile/recreations.tsx) reference outstandingAccpayInvoicesFor and will change. New navigation from list rows to Booking detail is needed on both mobile and web with Back handling (lookbackState router state). Dependency: US-08.3.1 (payable pair) defines 'unpaid payables', so what counts as outstanding should be checked against the payable/disbursement state, not only payer receipts. OQ-123 is unresolved: at most keep a hook; no build required until answered. Demo script impact: S3 style payment/balances beat (03-demo-script.md ~lines 698, 753-767, 904) and the URL table entry 'Accounts, outstanding /web/accounts/overdue' (line 71) mention Overdue/ageing and would change wording; the Beat 3 statement that a paid invoice 'remains under Overdue because no longer outstanding' needs rewording.

epics.title: Admin oversight and master data
epics.observations:
STRUCTURAL: the 18 Nov decision (Donald, surgeon contacts, no rooms) Retires the surgeons' room master. The prototype's Surgeon.roomIds, SurgeonRoom (email, phone, RoomContact[]), the "Surgeons' rooms" master view, RoomContactsList and room sheets, store roomContactActions and domain/roomContacts.ts (roomEmailForSurgeon) are all superseded. One piece of work closes FT-13.6, US-13.6.2, US-13.6.5 and the rooms part of US-13.4.1 (and the practice-name part of US-13.4.3): put the practice name (plain text), a personal contact and one or more office contacts (name, email, phone; always-one-set plus/minus form) on the Surgeon; make HPI CPN optional but unique and drop roomRequired; convert seeded rooms and the ~130 directory PA contacts into practice-name text and office contacts; re-point email resolution (List source address, else the surgeon's first office contact); bump PERSIST_VERSION; update component catalogue rows and tests (mastersPages, surgeonMasters seed test, roomContactsGuard, surgeonActions tests). Count it as one L, not several.

OTHER GAPS: (1) US-13.4.1 names a master (public holiday) calendar that the prototype lacks; only per-hospital closure calendars exist (the catalogue is slightly ambiguous because FT-01.5 describes hospital calendars only). (2) US-13.1.1 belongs with US-01.2.1/US-01.2.2/OQ-139: Public should be a Slot status with a note and no List detail, whereas the seed makes public a List kind with surgeon and hospital in recurring bookings; removing it touches recurring bookings, Assign List kinds and the day grid. (3) US-13.7.1's patient-balance warning is the same work as US-11.3.2. (4) FT-13.5: audit rows for payments, receipts and disbursements contradict US-13.5.2 (Agreed); fix by excluding them from the Audit viewer (S3 money beats at demo-script ~900 and 902 produce them). US-13.5.3 sign-in is the one wholly Missing item and needs OQ-83 answers only for details; a simulated login gate plus Show sign-in demo trigger is enough. (5) US-13.4.3 depends on the same HPI-CPN-optional change and OQ-143.

MATCHES: pairing stories US-13.6.3 (Agreed, re-checked against every AC), US-13.6.4 and surgeon specialties US-13.6.6 are fully built (catch-up Phases 17 and 18a).

DEMO SCRIPT IMPACT (docs/demo-guide/03-demo-script.md): lines ~85, 92, 93 name /admin/masters?view=surgeonRooms and the surgeon profile and will change; the S2 beat near line 266 (adds a Public hospital status by hand) changes if Public becomes a seeded status; S2 assignment beats using pairings and tiers are unaffected; S3 money beats produce the payment audit rows; a sign-in trigger would be a new optional beat in S5 or the mobile part of S1.

NOTES: the RolesInfo 'switch persona in the app switcher' copy is accurate (the switcher sets the persona), so it is not stale. splitDoesNotFit is an extra warning rule not listed in US-13.7.1.

epics.title: Non-functional requirements
epics.observations: EP-15 has two in-scope stories, both support (US-15.0.8, US-15.0.9). Neither has any implementation: there is no help entry, phone number, hours text or ticket entity in any app (searched aa-prototype/src broadly). Both belong with planned Phase 43a (Help panel with phone, email, hours and mock tickets, decision D83), but 43a names only US-15.0.8; US-15.0.9 needs adding to its scope (a Product support tab with its own response table and the after-hours, public holiday and Christmas/New Year cover). D83's hours text is stale: since the 18 November answer to OQ-137 the hours are 8:30am to 5:00pm NZT Monday to Friday excluding NZ public holidays; help line P3 is 4 hours, product support P3 is 3 business days; the help line has no after-hours cover except a security breach or platform offline, while product support is best effort after hours with public holiday call-out only with AA's approval. OQ-141 (cover from 8:00am) is open and also affects US-02.5.4, so keep the hours as one config value. Dependencies: the demo clock (DEMO_TODAY 2026-07-21, a Tuesday) for the in-hours and after-hours rule, the NZ public holiday seed, and a PERSIST_VERSION bump if tickets are seeded or stored. Adding a Help entry is additive and breaks no S1 to S5 beat; only the presenter cheat sheet needs a line.

items.summary: Epic's own model (rolling canvas, AM/PM Slot per anaesthetist, free by default, List placed in a Slot, Draft List with no anaesthetist, 'slot' never in UI) is built; real gaps sit in children US-01.5.2, 01.5.4, 01.6.3, 01.4.7.

items.prototype_does: Slots stored for every active anaesthetist/day/session across the horizon; one List per Slot; DRAFT Lists with no anaesthetist/slot; UI says session/Draft List; hospital+surgeon required on every List.
evidence: searched: user-visible strings containing 'slot' in apps/shared/store/domain -> none (actionLabels.ts:78 says none)
items.verify_note: Re-read canvas.ts and grepped for user-facing 'slot' copy; none. Epic body states its own rules but the prototype satisfies them. The one epic-level tension is the seeded List on an Unavailable session (graded under US-01.5.2), not the model itself.

WRONG: a phone-advice booked List stays statusKey 'free' and shows Free in anaesthetist apps and the finders (see US-01.2.3)
No calendar, series or web availability setting (see US-01.5.3)
Block on a booked Slot flags a conflict instead of return/assign (US-01.5.5)

items.summary: A free session carries no surgeon/hospital and a booked List carries one hospital/surgeon/day/session with its anaesthetist, but no Draft List and 'exactly one surgeon and hospital' is not enforced on an active List.
items.requirement_says: A Slot with no List has no surgeon or hospital. A List sits in one Slot and, once assigned, has exactly one anaesthetist, surgeon, hospital, day and session (active List); a Draft List has all but the anaesthetist.
items.prototype_does: Generated free Lists have no hospital/surgeon. Booked Lists carry hospitalId/surgeonId, date, session and anaesthetist on one record. hospitalId and surgeonId are optional: EditListSheet allows 'None (AA rooms / unassigned)' hospital, private Lists can be 'Surgeon TBC' (amber flag), public/preop can have no surgeon, phone-advice surgeon optional. No null-anaesthetist List.

'Active List has exactly one surgeon and one hospital' not enforced: surgeonId/hospitalId optional (EditListSheet.tsx:79, admin util.ts:104-117, PhoneAdviceBooking surgeon optional).
List.state DRAFT currently means 'assigned and being worked' (old reading); catalogue now calls that ACTIVE and reserves DRAFT for unassigned (EP-07 rename dependency).
items.verify_note: Confirmed optional hospital/surgeon fields and no Draft state; added EditListSheet 'None (AA rooms / unassigned)'. Not Contradicts: leniency is not a wrong behaviour contradicting a stated rule, mainly missing enforcement. Size M is mostly the Draft/ACTIVE state work shared with FT-01.6 and EP-07.

items.title: Draft Lists

items.summary: One generator writes an AM and a PM Slot per active anaesthetist per day, all Free, paints leave and series, then recurring bookings on top. A recurring booking on a closed Slot becomes a Draft List. Views show free and leave sessions.
items.requirement_says: The Scheduling Engine creates an AM and a PM Slot for every active anaesthetist for every day across the rolling horizon, even with no List. New Slots start free. Generation paints the anaesthetist's calendar first, then recurring bookings on top. A recurring booking on an unavailable Slot becomes a Draft List. One List per Slot. Out-of-hours is never generated.
items.prototype_does: generateCanvasForDates writes AM and PM only, from each anaesthetist's start date. Each Slot starts at the default (Free) status. Seed leave and series are painted next. Recurring bookings then go on top, and a clash on a closed status is returned as a clash and turned into a Draft List by the store (clashDraftsInto). Admin Day grid, mobile Forward Lists (open and day-off rows), web Lists table rows (open session rows with 'open for bookings' text) and the web Dashboard all show free and leave sessions. One List per Slot is enforced. The clock roll-forward uses the same generator.
evidence: aa-prototype/src/domain/seed/canvas.ts:121-170 (default status, then leave and series, then recurring on top, clashes pushed)
aa-prototype/src/apps/web/screens/ListsScreen.tsx:116-128 (upcoming rows from SlotViews, including empty sessions)
items.verify_note: I re-read canvas.ts and confirmed the order: free default, then leave and series, then recurring on top, with a closed status turned into a clash. I confirmed clashDraftsInto exists and the web and mobile views build rows from Slot views, so free and leave sessions show. I found no criterion that is unmet. The Notes' 'split session' exception (US-01.1.5) is explicitly not yet in force.

items.summary: Admins set default AM, PM and out-of-hours times in Schedule settings. A session can override them with its own times, and 'Use default' clears the override. An all-day booking is simply AM plus PM.
items.requirement_says: Admins set default start and end times for AM and PM Slots and for the out-of-hours Slot (18:00 by default). Each Slot can override the defaults. An all-day booking uses both AM and PM. A Slot keeps its standard shape on screen even when its List has one Booking.
items.prototype_does: Master data > Schedule settings shows a table over SESSIONS_IN_ORDER (AM, PM, OOH) and an edit sheet. setSlotDefaultTimes is office-only and checks HH:mm and start before end. Sessions without their own times follow at once (effectiveSlotTimes). Per-session overrides are set through SessionTimesFields (with 'Use default'), setSlotTimes and the OOH PM-end rule. The seeded defaults are AM 07:30-12:30, PM 13:00-17:30 and OOH 18:00-21:00. There is no all-day type, so an all-day booking is AM plus PM.
items.verify_note: I checked that the OOH default (18:00) is part of the same settings table and action, and that overrides are per Slot, with a default equal to the Slot's time left unset so later default changes reach it. The 'standard shape' note needs no behaviour beyond the Slot's default-times block. Nothing contradicts the requirement.
items.title: Slot default times

items.summary: Nothing lets an admin split an AM or PM session into A and B Lists: a Slot holds at most one List in the types, store guards, selectors and all three apps. The story is only Proposed, with design points unresolved.
items.requirement_says: An admin can split an anaesthetist's AM or PM session into two Lists (AM A and AM B, or PM A and PM B), each with its own surgeon, hospital and Bookings, following the pairing rule. At most two per session, the split is not offered again once split, and Lists are not split by default (recurring-booking Lists included). It is the one exception to one List per Slot. Proposed: per-half times, how a List already holding Bookings is split, finder and schedule treatment and Draft List halves are undecided.
items.prototype_does: Nothing. AssignedList has a single slotId, SlotView carries one optional list, and assignListToSlot (and the move and Draft assignment paths) refuse an occupied Slot with slotOccupied. Session is only 'AM' | 'PM'; no A/B designator exists on List or Slot. The Admin SlotDrawer offers Assign List on an empty session and shows the single List otherwise. Searches for split, half, A/B and two-surgeon concepts in non-test src found nothing relevant.
missing_or_wrong: No A/B half designator on List and no way for a Slot to hold two Lists (SlotView.list and listInSlot are singular; domain-model ERD says SLOT holds at most one LIST)
No admin 'Split session' action in the SlotDrawer, and no guard preventing a second split
Admin Day grid block, web ListsScreen and WeekStrip, and mobile forward lists show one List per session; each would need two stacked or halved rows
Projected recurring Lists must stay unsplit and Draft List half handling is undefined
Conflict derivation, move, assign, booking counts, billing and submit flows assume one List per Slot
Seed has no split example; no demo path or S1 to S5 beat
evidence: searched: split|half|listHalf|two surgeons|'A' | 'B' in aa-prototype/src (ts/tsx, non-test) -> no relevant hits
items.demo_trigger: Admin Day, session drawer on an assigned or empty session: a 'Split between two surgeons' button that creates AM A / AM B (or PM A / PM B) Lists, each with its own surgeon and hospital. The control hides once the session is split. Because the story is Proposed, hold the build until Donald and Greg agree, or build it behind a clearly marked option.
items.verify_note: Searched the code with several vocabularies (split, half, A/B, out of hours) and read assignListToSlot and the AssignedList type: strictly one List per Slot, no split concept. Missing is correct. Dropped nothing; the reviewer's list of missing points is real. Added that projected recurring Lists must stay unsplit by default (acceptance criterion 'Normal by default') and that the Draft List half question is open.
items.title: Split a session between two surgeons

items.summary: The office opens (today or later, one a day, own times allowed), fills (new List or Draft List) and closes an empty out-of-hours session. It is never generated and the anaesthetist cannot open one. It shows after PM, and finders offer it only when free. Every acceptance criterion is covered.
items.requirement_says: The office opens one out-of-hours Slot per anaesthetist per day (today included). It starts free at 18:00 by default with its own times allowed. It is never generated and the anaesthetist cannot open one. The finder offers it when free. The office assigns a new List or a Draft List to it. Marking it unavailable while it holds a List follows the normal rule. The office can close an empty one. Billing is as for any List.
items.prototype_does: openOutOfHoursSession is office-only (refusal for non-office or integration), refuses past dates, a day with no row and a second one. It takes optional own times, validated against the PM end, and stores times equal to the default as unset. The Day grid shows a per-row hover 'open out-of-hours session' button (only when the selected date is today or later and none is open). OpenOutOfHoursSheet has SessionTimesFields, and the drawer then offers Assign List or a Draft List. closeOutOfHoursSession is refused while a List is held. The generator writes AM and PM only. The anaesthetist's setAvailabilityRange refuses an OOH day with no open session ('There is no out-of-hours session open'). The OOH session shows after PM on mobile Forward Lists, the web Lists table, the web Dashboard, mobile and web Find cover, and the availability editor. Marking OOH unavailable with a List goes through holdsListRefusal and the move choice. Admin Find available has an OOH segment, and openSlotViews counts it only when free. The PWA stand-in 'office-adds-out-of-hours-list' exists. Billing has no OOH special case.
items.demo_trigger: Existing: the admin Day grid 'Open out-of-hours session' hover button for the office side, and the PWA stand-in 'office-adds-out-of-hours-list' for the anaesthetist-app view. Nothing further needed.
items.verify_note: I walked every acceptance criterion (opened by the office, same day, none until opened, one a day, own times, availability, Draft List for the evening, marked unavailable while booked, close an empty one) through the domain refusals, store actions and screens. Each is implemented. The button is gated on today or later, so the same-day case works. The 'who may open it when the office is closed' point is a declared open item, not an acceptance criterion.
items.title: Out-of-hours Lists

items.summary: Free, Holiday and Unavailable work for anaesthetist and office, with notes and instant office visibility, but Public is not a status and the validator refuses the label "Public", against the OQ-139 reading now in the story.
items.requirement_says: An anaesthetist or the office sets each Slot's availability from the master list (Free default, On holiday, Unavailable, Public). Public works like Unavailable: not bookable, no List detail, short note such as "CPH"; back to Free reopens it.
items.prototype_does: Three seeded statuses only (free, holiday, unavailable). Anaesthetists set them per session or range with an optional note, and the office sets a session's status via SessionStatusSheet and setAvailability. There is no Public availability status and validateSlotStatusDraft rejects the label "Public" (kindClash, "Public is a List type, not availability"). Public exists only as a List kind with its own fixed label and colour.
missing_or_wrong: No Public status in SEED_SLOT_STATUSES or SEED_STATUS, so the Public with note "CPH" criterion cannot be shown or set by an anaesthetist

validateSlotStatusDraft kindClash (slotStatus.ts:218-219) refuses the exact label "Public", so an admin cannot add it either ("Public hospital" would pass, which is a workaround, not the requirement). Implemented behaviour contradicts OQ-139
Back-to-Free for a Public Slot and the office-sets-Public criterion cannot be demonstrated until the status exists (the underlying set mechanism works)
No seeded Public sessions with a "CPH" note, so the Day grid, availability grid and mobile calendar show nothing for Public

Collision to decide: LIST_KIND_LABELS.public ("Public" chip for public-hospital Lists) and DisplayKey = ListKind | SlotStatusKey share one key space and resolveDisplayStatus tests isListKind first, so a seeded status keyed 'public' would resolve as the List kind; its key must differ (admin-added keys are allocated IDs, so they cannot collide)
evidence: aa-prototype/src/domain/seed/cast.ts:223-257 (three statuses; comment says public is a List attribute)
searched: cph in src -> only a hospital name 'Christchurch Public'; no Public availability status or note seeded
items.verify_note: Re-read the story (Verify, OQ-139 added Public with AC Public, Back to Free, Office sets it) and the code. Confirmed seed has three statuses and the validator refuses "Public". Added the DisplayKey key-space collision with List kind 'public' (seed key must not be 'public') and the missing seeded CPH sessions. PERSIST_VERSION is 50 as the reviewer said. Contradicts rather than Partial is right because refusing the label is implemented wrong behaviour.

items.summary: The availability-status master (fixed ID, editable label and colour, add, rename, retire, rules read IDs) is built and meets both acceptance criteria, but the starting set lacks Public and the editor refuses the label "Public", which the story now lists as a starting value.

Starting values include Public, which works like Unavailable and whose colour can be Unavailable's or its own.

items.requirement_says: Admin sets Tier 1 to 4 per anaesthetist (default Tier 4); lists of available anaesthetists to fill or cover a List are ordered by tier, shuffled within a tier, filterable by tier; only admin sees tiers and anaesthetists' own colleague views are not tier-ordered.
items.prototype_does: AnaesthetistRecord has a Priority tier control calling setPriorityTier (office-only, audited, validates 1 to 4); tierFor defaults to DEFAULT_PRIORITY_TIER 4 so a new anaesthetist is Tier 4. rankAnaesthetistCandidates sorts by tier then preferred then keeps a seeded shuffle keyed on scope:suggestionSeq, and useSuggestionKey bumps the counter each time a picker opens so the order varies between requests. AnaesthetistCandidates and DraftListCandidates both offer a "Filter by tier" segmented control (All, Tier 1 to Tier 4). Used by the availability finder, reassign flow, office status cover route and Draft List picker and drawer. Mobile and web colleague views use name order with no tiers.
items.demo_trigger: Existing: reopening the availability finder or Draft List picker bumps the suggestion key and reshuffles within a tier; Reset replays the same order. No extra control needed.
items.verify_note: Status is Verify (3), so checked all five ACs against code: Default (tierFor fallback 4), Ordered (sort by tier), Shuffled (seeded per-opening key), Filter (single-tier segmented control on both pickers), Admin only (no tier code in mobile, web or PWA, import-boundary test). Tier names are provisional Tier 1 to 4, as the note allows. No quietly changed behaviour found.

items.summary: Admin and anaesthetists each have a finder across all anaesthetists by day, and OOH is offered when open and free. For admins the free anaesthetists are listed by tier then preferred pairing, sequencing only, never auto-assigning. Anaesthetists see colleagues by availability alone, with no tier or pairing. When moving a Booking or List, a name search filters as letters are typed.

It has a tier filter, a name type-ahead and a Not preferred group when a surgeon is chosen. Picking a row opens Assign List and assigns nothing. The admin Day grid shows everyone. The web Find cover grid has day navigation, Everyone or Free only (with a count), a name search and an OOH column when anyone has one open. The mobile Find cover has a day strip, Everyone or Free only and free cells, with no tier or pairing. MoveListSheet and MoveBookingToColleagueSheet list colleagues by name with a 'Find a colleague' NameSearchBox. officePrivacy.test.ts keeps tier and pairing out of the anaesthetist apps.

items.summary: The anaesthetist's own List move offers colleagues as one flat surname-ordered list by availability alone, with no warning, no preference or tier revealed, and a shared-pool notification to the office.

items.summary: Owner-only submit and the office's Booking move work, but a prepaid Booking's payable goes to the anaesthetist on the List, not an AA Holding account, so a move leaves it with the wrong person; the anaesthetist-led move to a new List does not exist (status Verify).
items.requirement_says: Whoever submits a List did all its procedures; a Booking done by another anaesthetist is moved to that anaesthetist's List (even a single-Booking List). Unprepaid: payable follows the Booking to the doer. Prepaid: payable is the AA Holding account and does not move, the doer is paid from it at settlement; nothing is recalculated or re-triggered on the move.
items.prototype_does: submitList is owner-only and needs every non-cancelled Booking completed; anaesthetists cannot edit another's List. The office can move one Booking to any non-AUTHORISED List (MoveBookingFlow to reassignBooking), which touches no prepayment or invoice. The Xero handoff derives the ACCPAY payee from the Booking's List's anaesthetist at handoff time, so an unprepaid Booking moved before handoff is paid to the new anaesthetist. A prepayment invoice also hands off at once with a payable to the List's anaesthetist (raisePreProcedureInvoice then handoffCasesForBooking); there is no AA Holding creditor and no settlement transfer, and an already-created accPay keeps its anaesthetistId after a move (code comments mark a 'Phase 41 seam').
missing_or_wrong: No AA Holding payable: a prepaid Booking's ACCPAY is created for the anaesthetist on the List at handoff and never repointed, so after a move A stays the payee and B, who did the work, is not paid from it (contradicts AC 3 and AC 4). The prepayment itself is still the old deposit/self-funded model rather than the Contract-flagged full-amount prepayment of EP-06.
An already-handed-off unprepaid ACCPAY is not repointed when the Booking later moves (payee fixed at handoff).

An anaesthetist cannot move a Booking to a colleague as a new List: reassignBooking refuses anaesthetists unless both Lists are their own (notOwnList), the older reading. Only the office path produces 'Booking ends up on B's List' (see US-01.4.7).

items.summary: Change types exist as HL7 event handling and are audited with source, but changes apply automatically without pre-apply classification or office approval, and a day move is a reassign rather than cancel plus new Booking. Feature Agreed; OQ-124 open.

items.prototype_does: Classification is implicit in the canned event type (S12 new, S13 reschedule, S14 modify, S15 cancel); each lands in audited store actions (booking.create, booking.edit, booking.cancel, booking.reassign) as actor source 'integration', visible in the Booking history and the Audit viewer. The S12 hospital create is an interim stand-in for the hospital download (store/integrationActions.ts:169-171). items.prototype_does: Procedure.isPrimary: addProcedure always adds isPrimary false; removeProcedure refuses the primary and never promotes another; setPrimaryProcedure swaps via Make primary. primaryOf/inDisplayOrder/baseOn put base units and modifiers on the primary, listed first. BtmCaptureBlock shows a 'Primary' pill (when several) and an additional-procedure notice. Billing pre-flight (validateBookingForBilling) fails on zero or several primaries. Seed bookings each have one primary (seed.test.ts checks), the addendum Procedure is its own Booking's primary.

items.summary: Anaesthetist and office can add further Procedures to a Booking, but the new Procedure silently inherits the first Procedure's Contract; the anaesthetist has no way to select its own Contract and the office select is unfiltered.

items.summary: RVG type-ahead with code, description and base units, required on RVG Contracts only, Contract default fill, ranged base units, out-of-range accepted with an office warning, and reset on Contract change all match.
items.requirement_says: On an RVG-priced Contract the anaesthetist picks the RVG code by type-ahead (code, short description, base units per row); required on RVG Contracts, optional for reference on fixed/open; the Contract's default code fills when none is set; base units start from the code and modifier units at 0 plus system-applied ones; any value allowed, out of range raises an after-procedure warning; ranged codes show the range and let the anaesthetist choose; changing the Contract clears a typed price and keeps recorded units.
items.prototype_does: RvgCodeField: typed-in combobox on web/admin, bottom-sheet CodePickerSheet on the phone (search box focused, 'Type a code such as H1', rows from RvgCodeList with code, description, base units). completion.ts requires the code only when asksRvgDetail (RVG kinds); fixed/open show 'for reference' caption. fillFromContract fills defaultRvgGroupId when the Procedure has none, at Contract pick and applyContractChange, which clears enteredPrice and keeps code, units, times and modifiers. Ranged groups show RangeUnitsRow (primary only) from the starting figure; out-of-range values are accepted and baseUnitsOutsideGuideRule raises a mild afterProcedure warning for the office, registered in WARNING_RULES.
items.verify_note: Walked each acceptance criterion against the code (type-ahead, required on RVG, default fill, starting units, reset on change, ranged, out of range) and found an implementation for every one, on both phone and web. Medium confidence only because I did not run the UI.

Boundaries (turns 2 none, 80 A2, 1 or 70 A1) follow from the bands.

items.summary: The Contract change mechanics match every acceptance criterion except that the billed payer is the Booking's single payer, where the story now says the Procedure's own payer (US-11.2.2, Donald 17 Nov).
items.requirement_says: Until the List is AUTHORISED the anaesthetist changes a Procedure's Contract with no reason. A typed price is cleared, recorded RVG detail is kept, and the RVG code fills only when empty. Every change is audited and flagged at office review. Moving off an insurer Contract to No contract · RVG bills the Procedure's payer (the patient or someone else). The anaesthetist can never move a Procedure onto or off a prepaid Contract and is never offered one.
items.prototype_does: setProcedureContract is gated by editRefusal, which refuses only an AUTHORISED List and allows ACTIVE and SUBMITTED ones. It asks no reason and goes through contractPickRefusal and contractChangeRefusal. applyContractChange clears priceOverride, enteredPrice and railAnswers and fills the RVG code only when empty. withRvgRowChange keeps the recorded RVG detail. One audited 'procedure.contract' entry holds before and after, and any earlier office approval stamp is dropped. Review shows the changed-by flag. contractChangeRefusal blocks an anaesthetist onto or off a prepaid Contract. ProcedureContractRow shows 'Set by the office' in place of Change on a prepaid Procedure. The rail lists no prepaid Contract for the anaesthetist, only a greyed, non-selectable 'Prepaid · Set by the office' payment-type answer. No contract · RVG bills payerCounterparty(booking), the single Booking.payer. Procedure has no payer field.
missing_or_wrong: 'Pre-approval falls through' now bills the Procedure's own payer. The prototype bills Booking.payer through whoIsBilled.ts payerCounterparty and billablePartyForProcedure, and the Procedure interface in types.ts has no payer. Two Procedures on one Booking cannot bill different people. For a single-payer Booking the result matches the AC.

The payer is edited on the Booking (setBookingPayer, 'booking-payer-row' in BookingDetailBody), and there is no Procedure-level 'Paid by' line or offer to copy a change to the Booking's other Procedures. This belongs to US-11.2.2 rather than this story, but it is what makes this AC only partly met.

The greyed 'Prepaid · Set by the office' payment-type answer on the anaesthetist's rail is consistent with Donald's 16 Nov ruling in the code comment, because no prepaid Contract is offered. It is not a gap.
items.verify_note: I re-opened the story, US-11.2.2, setProcedureContract, editRefusal, contractRail, ProcedureContractRow, whoIsBilled and types.ts. The Contract-change behaviour is as the reviewer described. The only real gap is the payer on each Procedure, and nothing implemented contradicts the story. Booking.payer is a deliberate earlier reading, so Partial fits better than Contradicts. I kept size S for this story, because the payer move itself belongs to US-11.2.2 (cross-epic M or L) and this story only needs a re-check afterwards. I did not check the screenshots listed in the frontmatter.

Reason mandatory

items.summary: A post-op charge ends up on its own invoice traceable to the original, and fixed-amount billing lines (description plus amount) exist on a Procedure, but there is no event-level billing: no next-run pick-up, no bundling by billable party, no credit event, no invoice tick, and no event review step.
items.requirement_says: A billing event is a free-form charge (description plus amount) or a credit on a Procedure; if marked for invoicing it is billed in the next billing run through the standard review step, never held for the Procedure's invoice; bundled onto the invoice for the same billable party in that run where possible, otherwise its own invoice traceable to the Procedure; not invoiced if not reviewed or if the tick is cleared; a credit reduces what is owed and is traceable.
items.prototype_does: The billing run is per-List and fires synchronously when a List is authorised (runBillingForList, grouped by counterparty per Booking). A post-op addendum Booking on its own List is billed by its own run as a separate invoice and links back via addendumOfBookingId. Separately, addBillingLine adds fixed or rate x time lines with a free-text description to a Procedure before authorisation. Invoice.kind is only standard|prePayment; a negative price override is blocked as a credit note 'this system never raises'.
missing_or_wrong: MISSING: event-level 'next billing run'; there is only the per-List run on authorise
MISSING: bundling an event onto another invoice for the same billable party in the run; the addendum always gets its own invoice
MISSING: credit event or credit note path; the validator refuses negative totals (validateBookingForBilling.ts:203-215)
MISSING: invoice tick box (cleared = not invoiced)
MISSING: 'not through review = not invoiced' for events; review is the List authorise, tied to a session
MISSING: event billable party differing from the Procedure's
MISSING: description plus amount as an event; billing lines attach only before authorisation on a Procedure, and rate x time must pass the Method 3 gate
Related: additional invoice US-08.6.3 and credit note US-08.6.5 belong to EP-08

items.requirement_says: A Contract is one priced item, held by a Party, billing its holder or the Procedure's payer, priced by one of five kinds, Active or Disabled; every Procedure has exactly one Contract picked on the step rail.

items.verify_note: Re-read EP-04 body: intro paragraph, 'so every Procedure knows...' rationale, a Technical discussion pointing to US-08.6.2 for disputes, and a note on the name 'Contract'. No acceptance criteria and no rule not owned by a child. Grouping stands.
items.title: Contracts

items.summary: Feature introduces the office-kept catalogue of Parties and Contracts (create, edit, disable, audited); the rules sit in US-04.1.1 to US-04.1.5.
items.requirement_says: The office keeps the Contract catalogue: the Parties that hold Contracts and every Contract, creating, editing in place and disabling them, with every change audited.

items.verify_note: FT-04.1.md body is a one-paragraph summary pointing to US-04.1.x and US-13.4.3; the Notes record release scoping only. No acceptance criteria or own rule. Grouping confirmed.
items.title: Contract catalogue

items.summary: Feature states its own rule 'No setting is dated, only a fixed price through price ranges'; the prototype dates every Contract (effective from/to) and has no price ranges. The work is subsumed by US-04.1.2, US-04.2.2 and US-04.2.15.
items.requirement_says: A Contract is one priced item held by a Party whose settings say who it bills, where it is offered, how it is priced and how it appears on an invoice. No setting is dated: a change is an audited edit, a setting that must change from a date means a new Contract; only fixed prices are dated, via price ranges.
items.prototype_does: Every Contract carries effectiveFromISO and optional effectiveToISO, edited in the Contract sheet and used by isEffectiveOn to decide whether a contract applies on the List date; fixed price rows (ContractPrice) are undated.
missing_or_wrong: Contract-level effective from/to dates on every Contract (the older reading) instead of undated settings plus a new Contract for a dated change
No price ranges on fixed prices
Contract lacks the settings the feature lists (who billed, where offered, funding tag, specialties, invoice description)
items.verify_note: FT-04.2.md does state its own no-dated-settings rule, so it is graded, not Grouping. Confirmed dated Contract in types.ts/contracts.ts/ContractEditSheet. Size S is only the residual since the real work is counted on the child stories; standalone it would be M.
items.title: Contract definition

items.summary: Feature introduces exactly-one-Contract-per-Procedure picked on the step rail; the rules are in US-04.3.1 to US-04.3.11.
items.requirement_says: Every Procedure has exactly one Contract, picked by the office on a step rail from Active Contracts that fit the List (or the open-price fallback); the anaesthetist sees it and may change it.
items.prototype_does: Office-only billing-setup sheet with route control, insurer, payer and an unfiltered 'Governing contract' select; mobile/web show a read-only context line.
items.verify_note: FT-04.3.md restates US-04.3.1, 04.3.8, 04.3.2, 04.3.9 and US-03.4.1 with links and has no acceptance criteria. Grouping confirmed.
items.title: Contract selection on a Procedure

items.summary: The flat Contract model is built: every arrangement in the table is representable and seeded, no Contract kinds, destination derived from settings, rules enforced by one save guard.
items.requirement_says: Every arrangement is a Contract with the same settings (holder, who it bills, funding tag, pricing kind, prepaid, override). No kinds; destination (Patient, the List's hospital, Special) follows from settings. Any pricing kind under any destination except no RVG-priced prepaid; only RVG kinds may carry the override; a hospital may hold several Contracts for the same work.
items.prototype_does: Contract has holderId, billsTo, pricing kind (5), prepaid, anaesthetistMayOverridePrice, fundingTagId, no type or dates. destinationOf derives patient standard/prepaid, hospital+tag, or special (untagged hospital-billed goes to Special, as the domain model says). contractRefusal refuses prepaid RVG, prepaid not billing payer, override on non-RVG kinds, AA/anaesthetist holder billing holder. Seed covers No contract RVG, RVG at the anaesthetist's rate, rate Contracts, discount, surgeon fixed fees billing the payer, ACC/CES hospital-tagged items, Souter's prepaid list and open-price fallbacks per destination.
evidence: aa-prototype/src/domain/seed/contracts.ts:105-150 (stgAcc is hospital > ACC; the untagged hospital RVG Contracts sit under Special by the model's own rule)
items.verify_note: Re-read contractRefusal, destinationOf and the seed. The reviewer's 'seed variance' (no Forte SXAP RVG Contract) is not a gap: the editor can create it and a hospital > tag destination is seeded via the ACC Contract. Dropped it from missing_or_wrong.
items.title: Typical Contract arrangements

A Procedure keeps a disabled Contract; one not yet authorised and dated on or after the disable day is flagged at office review; earlier ones bill as normal.

Kinds AA (one), hospital (names its hospital), insurer, funder, surgeon or group, anaesthetist. Hospital-held: no links, only its hospital's Lists; surgeon/group/anaesthetist-held needs a link; unlinked AA/insurer/funder everywhere; specialties must match. Override is a per-Contract setting on RVG kinds only; the anaesthetist then changes the price with no reason and RVG detail kept; otherwise read-only and no own discount. Office can change any price.

items.verify_note: Re-read computedPriceOf, priceFor, anaesthetistMayTypePrice and rvgDetail against all seven acceptance criteria; no contradictions found.
items.title: Pricing kinds

When a new range covers authorised Procedures, which keep their old price, the app warns how many kept it and lists them.

Typed override is a field applied on top and persists across a Contract change. A prepayment deposit is netted by a 'Less pre-payment deposit already invoiced' line against the recomputed fee, so a changed fee yields a balance invoice (or a negative-total exception). No snapshot at AUTHORISED, no range dates.
