items.title: Track prepayment status and alert when outstanding

items.summary: Prepayment status is derived from the billing mirror, so each reconciled receipt re-checks it: part payment stays outstanding, full payment flips to paid and clears the warning.
items.requirement_says: After each prepayment receipt is reconciled the engine re-checks whether the prepayment requirement is still outstanding.
items.prototype_does: receivePayment (webhook or poll) mirrors received amount onto the prepayment BillingCase; paidPrePaymentCaseForBooking compares received >= invoice total; prepaymentStatusFor and the warning re-derive live. Payment received full/half triggers work on the prepayment invoice.
items.demo_trigger: Existing 'Payment received · full/half' triggers on admin invoice detail and the Xero simulation pair.
items.verify_note: Status Confirmed, re-checked: single sentence requirement; derived status re-evaluates after each receipt and triggers work on the prepayment invoice. Part-paid label gap belongs to US-06.3.2.
items.title: Re-check after each receipt

items.summary: The requirement is re-derived live and a move re-triggers nothing, but a Contract change after the prepayment invoice is sent or paid is not handled as a cancellation of the prepayment.
items.requirement_says: The prepayment requirement is re-checked whenever Procedures, a Procedure's Contract or its payer change before the procedure; a change to a non-prepaid Contract before the invoice is generated clears it; a move re-triggers nothing; a change after the invoice is sent or paid is treated as a cancellation of the prepayment (refunded if paid).
items.prototype_does: The requirement is derived live from each Procedure's Contract, so a change to a non-prepaid Contract before raising clears it and a payer change re-derives it. Moves (List or Booking) run no billing hook and keep Contracts. If the invoice is already raised and the Contract changes off prepaid, prepaymentStatusFor keeps the prepayment on the record as still owed, with no credit, refund or cancellation. setProcedureContract has no prepayment check apart from the typed-price gate.
missing_or_wrong: Contract changed after a prepayment invoice is sent or paid is not treated as a prepayment cancellation (no credit if unpaid, no refund if paid; US-06.3.7)
No invoice credit or holding-account reversal exists to call
The deliberate 'stays owed' reading in prepaymentStatusFor is the opposite of the requirement for the sent-or-paid case
evidence: aa-prototype/src/store/selectors.ts:638-644, :749-755 (derived; keeps an invoiced prepayment on the record)
items.demo_trigger: On the office Billing card of a Booking with a raised or paid prepayment, changing the Contract to a non-prepaid one shows a confirm 'Cancel the prepayment (credit the invoice / refund from the holding account)'. Existing Xero simulator 'Receive payment' sets up the paid path first.
items.verify_note: Checked the three acceptance criteria: Contract changed (before generated) and Move hold; Sent or paid is unmet. Considered Contradicts because the code keeps the prepayment owed, but that is an interim gap-filler for a missing cancellation feature, so Partial kept. Work depends on the US-06.3.7 / US-06.5.2 cancellation machinery, which carries most of the size.
items.title: Re-check when the Booking changes

items.summary: There is no prepayment letter or letter template master.
items.requirement_says: A standard, admin-maintained template fills in the prepayment letter (patient, procedure, prepaid amount, anaesthetist) and goes out with the prepayment invoice.
items.prototype_does: Nothing. The prepayment invoice is only a document view with an explanatory prepayment line. No letter, no template, no admin template maintenance.
missing_or_wrong: No letter template entity or admin screen
No merge fields (patient, procedure, amount, anaesthetist)
No letter sent with the invoice
OQ-120 (whether the anaesthetist is named) is open and does not change the grading
evidence: searched: 'letter|letterTemplate|prepayment letter' in aa-prototype/src -> only CSS letterSpacing and unrelated text
items.demo_trigger: On the admin prepayment approval screen: a letter preview that fills the template from the Booking, with an 'Edit template' link in Admin settings; on approval the letter shows as sent with the invoice.
items.verify_note: Agreed (status Agreed 4). Re-searched for letter or template vocabulary: nothing relevant.
items.title: Prepayment letter template

items.summary: Changing a Procedure off a prepaid Contract after the prepayment is sent or paid triggers no cancellation, credit note or refund.
items.requirement_says: A paid prepayment is refunded in full from the AA Holding account and a sent-unpaid one is credited, reversing the receivable and the holding-account payable; the Procedure is then invoiced under its new Contract after the procedure.
items.prototype_does: Nothing on a Contract change (there is no prepaid Contract). Credit notes, refunds and the holding account do not exist. Editing the category after an invoice is raised simply orphans the invoice, and the run nets the old prepayment into the next bill or raises a billing exception.
missing_or_wrong: No refund or credit on change off prepaid
No ledger reversal of the pair
No credit note entity or holding account
items.demo_trigger: On the admin Booking, after a prepayment invoice is raised, changing the Contract off prepaid opens a confirmation naming the refund or credit; the Ledger and Xero simulator then show the reversed pair. Paid or Sent-unpaid is chosen beforehand with the existing Xero simulator mark-paid action.
items.verify_note: Searched for credit or refund code: none. Missing upheld.
items.title: Contract changed after a prepayment is sent or paid

items.summary: A prepaid Procedure is still billed again on the final invoice (re-priced with a 'Less pre-payment deposit' deduction, and a split deposit's balance billed automatically); nothing is transferred from a holding account and there is no by-hand additional invoice or credit note.
items.requirement_says: At AUTHORISED a prepaid Procedure is priced at the prepaid amount, BTM units are reference only, and the only action is the transfer from the AA Holding account to the anaesthetist. No invoice or credit is raised automatically, no threshold. The anaesthetist or office can raise an additional invoice or a credit note by hand (a credit crediting the whole prepayment invoice). A prepaid Contract cannot carry the price-override setting; the price is read-only once the invoice is raised. The prepaid Procedure is left off the final invoice.
items.prototype_does: At authorise the lock prices the Procedure through the fee engine and appends a negative 'Less pre-payment deposit already invoiced' adjustment line, so the final invoice shows the Procedure netted to $0. A 'split' deposit prepayment bills the remaining balance (fee minus deposit) automatically, so extra work is invoiced with no person deciding. Prepaid price is read-only for the office once raised (PREPAID_PRICE_RAISED_MESSAGE) and a prepaid Contract is refused RVG pricing and so the override (both match). No by-hand additional invoice or credit note tied to a prepaid Procedure, and no whole-invoice credit rule.
missing_or_wrong: Prepaid Procedure is not left off the final invoice (an invoice with a deduction line instead)
Split-deposit shape bills an automatic balance, contradicting 'no extra invoice' and 'no threshold'
No automatic transfer from the AA Holding account to the anaesthetist at AUTHORISED (OQ-125)
No manual additional invoice or credit note on a prepaid Procedure (US-08.6.3, US-08.6.5), and no 'credit in full' rule
Anaesthetist's payable is created and paid at prepayment time, not at the transfer
evidence: aa-prototype/src/domain/billing/procedurePrice.ts:172-179 (deduction and deposit descriptions flagged for removal), :237-246 (price read-only after raise; matches)
aa-prototype/src/domain/billing/contracts.ts:316-320 (prepaid not RVG so no override; matches)
searched: additionalInvoice|creditNote in src -> only comments
items.demo_trigger: Existing 'Authorise list' (Admin) shows the transfer and the prepaid Procedure absent from the final invoice. Add on a prepaid Procedure's Booking 'Raise additional invoice' and 'Credit prepayment invoice' office buttons that appear only for prepaid Procedures, each producing a traceable new invoice or credit note.
items.verify_note: Re-read lock.ts and invoiceBuild: the deduction line and split balance are real and wrong. Confirmed that the no-override and read-only-price criteria do match. Note the manual additional invoice / credit note work overlaps US-08.6.3 and US-08.6.5 and should not be double counted.
items.title: Nothing further after a prepaid procedure

items.summary: There is no AA Holding account: the prepayment's payable is created to the List's anaesthetist and authorised as the money arrives, the opposite of the requirement.
items.requirement_says: A prepayment is credited to the AA Holding account, a payables creditor within trust accounting; the other side of the prepayment pair is the holding account, not an anaesthetist. Its balance is all deposits received for procedures not done. Nothing is paid to the anaesthetist until the procedure is done, when a second pair transfers it; money leaves only by a system transfer or refund.
items.prototype_does: handoffCasesForBooking gives the pre-invoice a full ACCREC+DRAFT ACCPAY pair payable to the List's anaesthetist. receivePayment authorises the ACCPAY to the cumulative amount and the payables run can disburse it, so the anaesthetist is paid on receipt. 'AA Holding account' appears only in code comments about moves.
missing_or_wrong: No holding account entity, contact or balance (no Xero creditor 'prepay account')
Payable on the prepayment pair names the anaesthetist, not the holding account
Money can be disbursed to the anaesthetist before the procedure is done
No holding-to-anaesthetist transfer pair; nothing restricts money leaving to a transfer or refund
No holding account view in the Xero simulator or the admin billing monitor
evidence: searched: holdingAccount|AA Holding|prepay account in src -> comments only
items.demo_trigger: Xero simulator (DemoXero) shows an 'AA Holding account' creditor card: balance rises on Receive payment and drops on 'Authorise list', when a transfer pair to the anaesthetist is shown. Payables run offers nothing to the anaesthetist for a prepaid Booking until then.
items.verify_note: Searched src for any holding-account entity (none outside comments) and re-read the pair builder and payment path. The seeded PAID prepayment case (seed/billing.ts) also pays the anaesthetist and would need re-pointing. Open point from the story's technical discussion (keeping the holding bill out of the payment run) is part of the build, not a gap in the grade.
items.title: AA Holding account

items.summary: Cancelling a prepaid Booking only soft-cancels it; no credit note or refund is raised and there is no holding account.
items.requirement_says: Cancelling a Booking with an unpaid prepayment automatically raises a credit note; with a paid prepayment the full amount is refunded from the AA Holding account, recorded as a credit reversing the receivable and the holding payable; a payment after the credit note is refunded.
items.prototype_does: cancelBooking marks the Booking cancelled with a reason and excludes it from billing, validation and the prepayment flag. The prepayment invoice, its case and its ACCPAY are left untouched; nothing is credited or refunded.
missing_or_wrong: No automatic credit note for an unpaid prepayment
No full refund for a paid prepayment
No ledger reversal linked to the original invoice
No handling of a later payment after the credit
The orphaned invoice and ACCPAY remain live in Xero after cancel
items.demo_trigger: Existing 'Cancel booking' on a prepaid Booking (seeded Annette Riley for the unpaid case, the seeded paid prepaid Booking for the refund case); afterwards the admin invoice view shows the credit or refund and the Xero simulator shows the reversed pair.
items.verify_note: Agreed (status Agreed 4). Read cancelBooking in full: it touches only the Booking. Considered Contradicts for the live orphaned invoice, but that is the absence of the behaviour rather than a wrong implementation, so Missing stands.
items.title: Cancellation of prepayment procedures

items.summary: A rebooked new Booking does start its own prepayment, but at an estimated fee rather than the new anaesthetist's fixed price, and the original is never credited or refunded.
items.requirement_says: After a prepaid Booking is cancelled (credited or refunded) and rebooked with a different anaesthetist, the new Booking raises its own prepayment at the new anaesthetist's own fixed price from their own price list.
items.prototype_does: A new Booking with selfFundedPrepayment independently requires prepayment and its own pre-invoice at a feeFor estimate (no contract line); the cancelled Booking's invoice stays untouched.
missing_or_wrong: WRONG: new prepayment amount is a calculator estimate, not the new anaesthetist's fixed price
Missing: the original prepayment settled on cancellation (US-06.5.2)
items.verify_note: Corrected Partial to Contradicts: the only acceptance criterion is 'a new prepayment is raised at their price', and the prototype raises it at an estimated fee, the behaviour the catalogue forbids (US-06.2.2). Medium confidence because the new-prepayment mechanism itself is the right shape; closing it is mostly covered by the amount fix in US-06.2.2 and the cancel reversal in US-06.5.2.
items.title: Prepayment for a replacement anaesthetist

items.summary: A move leaves the prepayment untouched and bills nothing again, but the existing payable stays with the original anaesthetist and there is no holding account, so the new anaesthetist is not paid from the prepayment.
items.requirement_says: On a move the ledger is unchanged and nothing is recalculated; the payable to the AA Holding account stays; the new anaesthetist is paid from the holding account after the procedure; an optional informational email may go to the patient.
items.prototype_does: reassignList and the own-List move re-check no prepayment and write no money (seam comment for a later payee repoint). The existing ACCPAY remains addressed to the original anaesthetist, and the later balance run bills against the List's current anaesthetist, so the prepaid money would be paid to the wrong person. No patient email.
missing_or_wrong: Payable stays with the original anaesthetist (no holding account)
No second-step transfer to the new anaesthetist
No optional patient email
Not-billed-again and no-recalculation ACs do hold
items.demo_trigger: Existing office 'Reassign List' or anaesthetist own-move on a prepaid Booking's List, then the admin ledger view shows the unchanged pair with the payable to the AA Holding account; an optional 'Email patient' button on the reassign sheet.
items.verify_note: Agreed (status Agreed 4). Considered Partial because the no-rebill and ledger-unchanged ACs hold, but the payable remaining with the old anaesthetist is wrong against the requirement text (the payable is the holding account), so Contradicts stands at medium confidence. It follows directly from the FT-06.3 contradiction.
items.title: Prepaid Booking moved to another anaesthetist

items.summary: State machine, submit, authorise, lock and billing handoff are built, but the anaesthetist is blocked from editing a SUBMITTED List (epic says anyone can until authorised) and Contract versions are not locked.
items.requirement_says: Four states; ACTIVE when five-part pairing complete; submit sends to office but the anaesthetist can still see it and anyone can change it until authorised (last change stands); authorising locks Bookings, Procedures and selected Contracts and hands the whole List to billing.
items.prototype_does: ListState DRAFT|ACTIVE|SUBMITTED|AUTHORISED with ordered guards; submitList completion-gated; authoriseList office-only, emits listAuthorised, billing run bills the whole List. editRefusal refuses the anaesthetist on any non-ACTIVE List ('Only the office can change it now'); submit sheet says they cannot change the bookings afterwards. No Contract version is locked.
missing_or_wrong: WRONG: anaesthetist cannot edit a SUBMITTED List (store/lifecycle.ts editRefusal ~:72); catalogue says anyone can until authorised, last change stands
WRONG: submit confirmation copy 'not be able to change these bookings afterwards' (SubmitListSheet.tsx:110)
MISSING: authorisation does not lock selected Contract versions (no Contract versioning; see US-07.3.1)
MISSING: submitted List not shown less prominently to the anaesthetist
items.verify_note: Re-read lifecycle.ts, BookingDetailBody canEdit, SubmitListSheet copy: edit block confirmed. Epic body states its own rules so not Grouping. Copy line is :110 not :76-79 (cosmetic).
items.title: List approval workflow

items.summary: ACTIVE is the five-part-paired state, reached by office assignment of a Draft List or set up with its anaesthetist (recurring booking), and reverting to Draft on move/withdraw/unavailable return.
items.requirement_says: A List is ACTIVE once it has anaesthetist, surgeon, hospital, day and session; reached by assigning a Draft List or being set up with its anaesthetist (e.g. recurring booking); anaesthetist completes Bookings then submits.
items.prototype_does: isActivePairing encodes the five-part rule (store-wide invariant test); assignDraftList flips DRAFT to ACTIVE; own move/withdraw/unavailable return detaches to DRAFT with anaesthetistId/slotId cleared; recurring bookings place Lists with anaesthetist (ACTIVE); Draft Lists refuse edit/complete/submit/authorise ('Assign an anaesthetist first').
items.verify_note: Checked each reach/revert path in code (assign, recurring placement, own move to office, unavailable return) and that DRAFT Lists are refused lifecycle actions. No acceptance criteria on this item; nothing contradicting found. Confidence raised to high.
items.title: ACTIVE

items.summary: Office review queue and SUBMITTED state exist, but the anaesthetist cannot change a submitted List and it is not shown less prominently.
items.requirement_says: After submit the office reviews and corrects; the anaesthetist can still see it and change it until authorised; submit makes it less prominent for the anaesthetist and tells the office it has work.
items.prototype_does: Admin Review queue lists SUBMITTED Lists with sidebar badge and count; office can edit SUBMITTED. Anaesthetist can view the List ('Submitted to office' footer) but all edit is blocked; mobile shows it under Done / same row style, no reduced prominence.
missing_or_wrong: WRONG: anaesthetist edit blocked on SUBMITTED
MISSING: Submitted List not shown less prominent to the anaesthetist (normal row, or under Done tab)
items.verify_note: Confirmed the same edit-block root cause; mobile ListDetailScreen:112 and web ListDetailView:112 both set canEdit = state === 'ACTIVE'. Prominence gap real (listRow uses same style, 'doneUnbilled' marker only). Fix is shared with US-07.2.1.
items.title: SUBMITTED

items.summary: Authorising locks the List and hands it to the billing run as one unit; every Booking/Procedure write is refused afterwards.
items.requirement_says: Once authorised a List is locked and handed to the Billing/Invoice Engine as a single unit so the engine works from a stable record.
items.prototype_does: authoriseList emits listAuthorised; wireBillingRun runs runBillingForList for the whole List in one commit then hands cases to Xero; editRefusal blocks all edits on AUTHORISED; moves and time changes on AUTHORISED Lists are refused too. Contract-version locking is a US-07.3.1/US-04.3.5 matter, not stated in this feature body.
items.verify_note: Feature body states only lock + single-unit handoff; both verified in code (event wiring, synchronous run, guards on moves/time edits). Contract-version lock is asserted by EP-07 and US-07.3.1, graded there.
items.title: AUTHORISED

items.summary: Authorised Lists leave the anaesthetist's views (billing run is synchronous), but invoices reach balances only the next day and there is no search to find the List afterwards.
items.requirement_says: Once authorised the List drops off the main view and its invoices show in outstanding balances; the anaesthetist can still find the List by search.
items.prototype_does: List disappears via billedAtISO, stamped by the billing run at authorisation. accpayInvoicesFor hides invoices raised today (next-day visibility). No List/Booking search for the anaesthetist in mobile or web.
missing_or_wrong: WRONG: balances hide invoices raised today (selectors.ts:922 next-day rule); 19 Oct notes say they should show quickly
MISSING: search by patient name, NHI or date for finished Lists (US-03.1.6)
evidence: searched: search in apps/mobile apps/web shared -> only AvailabilityGrid 'Search name' and CodePickerSheet; no List/Booking/patient search
items.verify_note: Confirmed next-day filter at selectors.ts:922 and absence of any anaesthetist search. Note: selectors.ts:383-388 comment says lists vanish at invoice generation not AUTHORISED; equivalent today only because run is synchronous. Search work belongs to US-03.1.6 (counted once).
items.title: List visibility in the anaesthetist app

items.summary: Submit is completion-gated in the store and on both anaesthetist apps, with a count and a per-Booking 'still to finish' list; the stale confirm copy belongs to US-07.2.1.
items.requirement_says: The anaesthetist can submit a List once every Booking is marked complete; the List becomes SUBMITTED. If any Booking is incomplete the submit is blocked and the system shows what is still missing.
items.prototype_does: submitList (ACTIVE to SUBMITTED) refuses with bookingsNotCompleted while any non-cancelled Booking is not completed. Mobile and web show a disabled 'Mark list completed · n to finish' control that opens SubmitListSheet mode=blockers, listing each incomplete Booking (time, patient) with its billing validation failures, or 'Ready to complete' when only Mark complete is left. When all are complete, a teal submit opens a confirm sheet, then the success overlay and a 'Submitted to office' state. Audited as list.submit.
evidence: aa-prototype/src/shared/flows/SubmitListSheet.tsx:34-90 (blockers mode lists each incomplete Booking and its failures)
items.verify_note: Re-read the story (one acceptance criterion: block and show what is missing) and submitList, SubmitListSheet and the mobile and web submit bars. The criterion is met, cancelled Bookings are excluded, and the blocker detail matches the 'what is still missing' link. The confirm sheet still says the anaesthetist cannot change Bookings afterwards; that contradicts US-07.2.1, not this story, so I kept it there. Status is Agreed, so I looked for hidden gaps and found none.
items.title: Submit a List

items.summary: The prototype locks a List to the anaesthetist the moment it is SUBMITTED (store refusal, hidden edit controls, copy); the requirement now says they can keep changing Bookings until the office authorises.
items.requirement_says: After submit the anaesthetist still sees the List and can change its Bookings until the office authorises it; changes are audited and the office sees them at review (last change stands). It stays visible, less prominent, scrolling up from today on the main view, until authorised. Once AUTHORISED the anaesthetist cannot change it.
items.prototype_does: editRefusal refuses an anaesthetist on any non-ACTIVE List with 'This List has been submitted. Only the office can change it now.' BookingDetailBody sets canEdit false for the anaesthetist on SUBMITTED, so edit, capture, attachment and cancel controls are hidden, and its comment says so deliberately. The submit confirm says 'You will not be able to change these bookings afterwards', and web shows a static 'Submitted to office'. AUTHORISED is locked for everyone (correct). Submitted and Authorised Lists show in the mobile 'Done' filter with a 'Done · unbilled' chip. All edits are audited via mutate(), and Admin Review reads live data.
missing_or_wrong: Anaesthetist edit on a SUBMITTED List is refused in the store (editRefusal 'listSubmitted'), the opposite of the rule
BookingDetailBody canEdit hides all edit controls from the anaesthetist when list.state is SUBMITTED
SubmitListSheet confirm copy and the web 'Submitted to office' static state say no further change is possible
No indication at Admin review that the anaesthetist changed something after submit (visible only in History)
Add Booking, amend (uncomplete) and attachments on a SUBMITTED List are unavailable to the anaesthetist

Visibility: the Done filter keeps a List until billedAtISO (isListBilled), i.e. past authorisation, where the rule says until authorised. Mobile Done is a flat list not tied to 'scrolling up from today'; the main-view placement under US-07.4.2 is not built as described
Existing tests and demo-guide persona text assert the old rule (e.g. 'ACTIVE: may edit', locked on submit)
evidence: aa-prototype/src/apps/web/screens/ListDetailView.tsx:293-327 (SubmitAction: static 'Submitted to office' when not ACTIVE)
items.verify_note: Re-opened editRefusal, BookingDetailBody canEdit, SubmitListSheet, the web SubmitAction and ForwardListsScreen. The contradiction is real and Contradicts (not Partial) is right, since implemented behaviour is the opposite of the rule. I added the demo-guide persona text and the ForwardListsScreen visibility detail (Done keeps Lists until billed, not until authorised). Size M stands: guards, shared Booking detail, both apps, copy, tests, plus a 'changed after submit' hint at review.
items.title: Anaesthetist can still edit a submitted List

items.summary: Office review is built to the current text (Contract approve/correct, per-Procedure Paid by with child warning, typed-price and no-longer-fits flags, needs-destination and needs-price flags), but the Disabled Contract flag (OQ-135, answered 18 Nov) is missing.
items.requirement_says: At SUBMITTED review the admin sees each Procedure's text, Contract and RVG code, insurer and approval number, each Procedure's own Paid by with a non-blocking under-18 warning per Procedure, references and invoice emails, and flags: a Contract the anaesthetist changed, a typed price beside the computed one, a Contract not offered on the List after a move, and a Disabled Contract on a Procedure dated on or after the day it was disabled (flagged, never blocked; approve or move; day taken from the Contract audit).
items.prototype_does: ReviewScreen shows per-Procedure stacks, Billed to with insurer and approval number, ReviewPaidBy per Procedure with an Under 18 pill driven by a per-procedure childPayer warning, Approve and Correct on a pending Contract change, and REVIEW_FLAG_RULES flags (contractChanged, contractNoLongerFits, needsInvoiceDestination, needsPrice, typedPrice, notCompleted, payerContactMissing, btmOverride). Flags do not block. A Disabled Contract raises no flag.
missing_or_wrong: No Disabled Contract review flag: REVIEW_FLAG_RULES has no such rule, and contractNoLongerFits calls contractAllowedOn(..., {anyStatus: true}), so a Disabled Contract is deliberately ignored. The header comment cites D81/OQ-135 as open with no-flag as the default. That default is now the opposite of the catalogue's answer.

No 'disabled on' date is available to review. disableContract only sets status 'disabled' (contractActions.ts:293-295). Per the OQ-135 answer the day comes from the contract.disable audit entry (a Contract has no dates of its own), so the flag rule needs the audit timestamp passed into the review input, or a derived map of disable dates. The 'dated on or after the disable day' test (1 Dec disabled, 3 Dec flagged, 28 Nov not flagged) cannot run today.

Seed has no Disabled Contract (searched status: 'disabled' in domain/seed, none) and no contract.disable audit entry, so the acceptance scenario cannot be shown without a seeded example or a demo path.
Stale comments and docs (reviewFlags.ts header, D81 note, disableContract docstring) still describe the no-flag default.

Minor: 'other references, addresses and invoice email addresses' appear only as payer email or post delivery and the missing-reference row. There is no separate references block on Review. This is probably acceptable since holder references were dropped (OQ-136).
evidence: aa-prototype/src/store/contractActions.ts:292-295 (disableContract sets status only; audit action contract.disable)
aa-prototype/src/apps/admin/screens/ReviewScreen.tsx:410-423 (ReviewPaidBy with child pill, Approve and Correct), :574-610 (flags with Approve and Correct), :627-654 (Under 18)
items.demo_trigger: Existing control: Disable in Master data > Contracts (ContractEditSheet 'Disable'), which writes the audit entry the date would be read from. For a presenter run, seed a Contract disabled on a past demo date (audit entry included) and a Booking dated after it on a SUBMITTED List so Review shows the flag without a new button. A demo clock jump covers the 'dated before the disable day is not flagged' case.
items.verify_note: Re-opened the story, OQ-135 (status 4, answered 18 Nov), reviewFlags.ts, contractActions.ts and ReviewScreen.tsx. Confirmed there is no Disabled flag and no disable date. Confirmed the other four acceptance criteria are met: payer shown and changeable, child warning per procedure via the childPayer warning keyed by procedureId, Contract change and typed-price flags, and flags that never block. Nothing implemented contradicts the text, since the status-ignoring behaviour is an absence rather than wrong behaviour, so Partial stands rather than Contradicts. Refinement: OQ-135 says the disable day comes from the Contract audit, so no new field on Contract is needed. The reviewer's claim that the date has no home is true, but the fix is to read the audit timestamp into the review input. Size M is kept (domain rule plus plumbing, a seeded disabled Contract with audit entry, a PERSIST_VERSION bump, test and demo-guide checks).
items.title: Office review of Contracts and references

items.summary: Office corrects Bookings directly with no Returned state (as required), but the clause that the anaesthetist can also still change it, last change standing, is contradicted by the edit block.
items.requirement_says: Admin corrects a Booking directly without sending it back; no 'returned' state; until authorised the anaesthetist can also change it and the last change stands.
items.prototype_does: Office edits SUBMITTED Bookings in Day view booking detail (edit, cancel, billing setup, price override) with audit; no return transition (logListNote only annotates; no Returned state anywhere). Anaesthetist edits on SUBMITTED are refused, so 'neither side has authority' cannot occur.
missing_or_wrong: WRONG: anaesthetist cannot change a submitted List (fix shared with US-07.2.1)
items.verify_note: Office-direct-correction and no-Returned halves confirmed. Contradicts rather than Partial because implemented behaviour (anaesthetist refused) differs from the stated rule. Size S assumes the US-07.2.1 guard fix lands first.
items.title: Office corrections

items.summary: Authorise, lock, whole-List handoff to billing and no partial release all work; the copy of the selected Contracts into each Procedure's pricing snapshot at authorisation does not exist.
items.requirement_says: The admin marks a submitted List AUTHORISED, locking its Bookings, Procedures and the Contracts selected for them (copied into each Procedure's pricing snapshot), and passes the whole List to the Billing/Invoice Engine as one unit. There is no partial release, and a failing Booking is held for a manual fix while the rest invoices.
items.prototype_does: authoriseList (office only, SUBMITTED only) sets AUTHORISED, audits list.authorise and emits listAuthorised. editRefusal then locks every Booking edit for all actors. The billing run invoices the whole List at once, with per-Booking failure held as a BillingCase while the others invoice, and the Billing monitor offers Resolve and retry. The Admin Review screen has a confirm overlay, an 'Authorised · locked' banner, lock icons and an 'N invoices raised' line. There is no return to the anaesthetist and no partial release.

Proposed resilience: async processing, durable queue with exponential-backoff retry, idempotency, handling of engine/Xero divergence (voided/amended in Xero, payment against a credited invoice), failure/recovery testing.

No automatic retry with exponential backoff, retry count or next-attempt visibility (manual Resolve & retry only)
No alerting of persistent handoff failure beyond the Billing Monitor chip
No divergence handling: an invoice voided/amended directly in Xero is never detected; no payment-against-credited-invoice ordering case
'voided' ACCREC status exists in types/UI but is never driven
Epic frames the engine ledger as system of record (US-08.3.2); prototype has no internal ledger, BillingCase + XeroAccRec/AccPay hold the money (dependency on EP-08)

'Restore Xero' drains the queue and pairs appear with no duplicates. Plus 'Void this invoice in Xero' on the pair detail so the next poll flags the mismatch for office resolution. Shell has no screen-contextual slot for these today, so they live on the Xero sim pair detail / control panel.

items.summary: The prototype records disbursement, but as an AA office action (Admin 'Run payables', and a Xero-simulator button that calls the same office function), not as the engine detecting an ACCPAY paid in Xero's payables run via webhook or poll; this is the older reading that OQ-111 (answered 4 Nov, not yet seen by Greg) now reverses. The system tracks payments, it does not make them.

The two-state split itself exists (receivedAmount vs disbursedAmount; chips in InvoiceDocument, Billing monitor, Web accounts). Webhook and poll machinery exists only for ACCREC payments; there is no ACCPAY-paid event, no Xero-side 'paid' state separate from the engine's record, and the daily poll does not detect payable payments.

items.summary: The feature body only introduces its stories (US-11.2.1 to 11.2.4, US-11.4.3): the Contract decides who is billed, the payer's details sit on the Procedure. The mechanism is built (billablePartyForProcedure) and is graded through the children.
items.requirement_says: The Contract alone decides who is billed for a Procedure: its holder or the Procedure's payer, with the payer's name and contact recorded on the Procedure.
items.prototype_does: billablePartyForProcedure uses only the Contract's billsTo: holder Party when it bills its holder, else the Procedure's own payer (patient or BP#### other payer). Billing run, Review, invoices and warnings read it. Party delivery method is email or post (OQ-114 default).
items.verify_note: Checked the code (whoIsBilled.ts takes the Contract's billsTo as the only input; funder never read) and agree the behaviour is built. The feature has no acceptance criteria and its two paragraphs only restate what US-11.2.1 and US-04.2.1 hold, so Grouping is the better label; size None either way. The one stale-copy nit found is recorded against US-11.2.2. OQ-114 open: prototype follows the default (email or post), not a gap.
items.title: Who is billed: holder or the Procedure's payer

items.summary: Only an informational 'Prior balance' pill on the admin Billing monitor; no admin patient-balance view, no alert when the patient is booked again, nothing for the anaesthetist.
items.requirement_says: Admins see a patient's unpaid invoices and are alerted when that patient is booked again while owing money or holding a credit; anaesthetists see the alert on the Booking in their List.
items.prototype_does: patientHasOutstandingPriorEpisode flags a billing-monitor row 'Prior balance' when another non-cancelled Booking for the patient has an unpaid case. No Patients view in Admin; no alert at booking creation/match; lists show no balance alert.
missing_or_wrong: No admin view of a patient's unpaid invoices across anaesthetists
No alert at booking creation or match, none in the admin or anaesthetist List
No credit-balance concept
Existing flag is at billing time, not at the next booking

items.verify_note: Grepped for owing/credit/outstanding across apps and shared; only the Prior-balance pill exists. Partial (concept present, rest missing) is right; nothing implemented contradicts it.
items.title: Patient outstanding balances and alerts

items.summary: NHI dedupe on a returning patient works, but a booking without an NHI creates a provisional patient record, which the requirement now forbids.
items.requirement_says: Exactly one patient record per NHI, matched by NHI even if name or address changed; every record has an NHI from creation (no blank); a booking without one waits at intake and creates no patient record; demographics and ethnicity optional.
items.prototype_does: upsertPatient validates and normalises NHI, reuses an existing patient by NHI (enriching missing contact fields, audit patient.reuse), else creates a record, marking it provisional when NHI is absent. Seed has provisional no-NHI patient PT0010 Noah Prescott. Ethnicity held and optional.
missing_or_wrong: NHI optional in upsertPatient (provisional create) and the Patient type (nhi?)
Manual booking form does not require NHI
No stub/wait-at-intake path for NHI-less bookings (US-11.1.4, US-02.6.1)
Seeded provisional no-NHI scenario contradicts 'no blank'
items.verify_note: Read intake.ts directly: the dedupe criterion is met, the provisional creation is the contradiction. Agreed status, so checked hard; no mitigating stub logic found.
items.title: Patient record keyed on NHI

items.summary: Both NHI formats are validated by one pure module with the right shapes and check characters, wired into booking creation, PDF ingest and an admin validator. Only the 'modulus 24' label for the current format differs, a deliberate documented ruling.
items.requirement_says: Validate current (AAANNNC, text says modulus 24) and new (AAANNAX, modulus 23) NHI formats; never assume numeric or sequential; working before 1 July 2027.
items.prototype_does: domain/nhi.ts validateNhi detects format by character class, checks current format by weighted mod 11 (the real Health NZ algorithm; RFP's own example ZAA0067 only validates under mod 11) and new format by mod 23, rejects I and O, gives plain reasons; generateNhi makes non-sequential seeded NHIs of both formats. Integrations Validators tab shows an NHI validator and says on screen that the RFP's 'Modulus 24' label does not fit its own examples.
items.demo_trigger: Existing: Admin, Integrations, Validators tab accepts ZAA0067 / ACA31FM and rejects a bad check digit.
items.verify_note: Read nhi.ts algorithms. Catalogue literally says modulus 24 for the current format but the prototype uses mod 11 by prior ruling and flags it on screen; behaviour a presenter shows (both formats validated, bad check rejected) satisfies the story, so kept Matches with medium confidence. If the catalogue wording is ever treated as binding this would become Contradicts, but switching to mod 24 would reject real NHIs.
items.title: Dual-format NHI validation

items.summary: The prototype implements the dropped reading: a Booking goes ahead for a provisional 'NHI pending' patient, instead of the NHI-less incoming booking waiting on the unmatched queue with a stub on its List and no Booking or patient record.
items.requirement_says: NHI mandatory; a Booking cannot be saved without one. An incoming booking without NHI is not a Booking: it waits on the unmatched queue (US-02.1.4) until the office adds the NHI, then matches and becomes a Booking; a stub shows on its List meanwhile; the 'NHI pending Booking' idea is dropped.
items.prototype_does: A Booking can be created and saved with a blank NHI via manual form, PDF row ingest and feed, with a provisional patient record. It shows 'NHI pending' on the web List detail and admin Review screen. No unmatched queue, no waiting intake row, no stub on the List.

WRONG: an incoming PDF row with blank NHI creates a Booking and provisional patient (ingestPdfRow) instead of waiting at intake
WRONG: 'NHI pending' badge on Bookings (concept dropped)
MISSING: unmatched queue holding NHI-less intake rows (US-02.1.4)
MISSING: office adds NHI to a waiting row, which then matches and becomes a Booking
MISSING: stub on the List while a row waits (FT-02.6)
evidence: aa-prototype/src/store/integrationActions.ts:456-495 ingestPdfRow creates Booking with optional NHI (:464 NHI validated only when non-blank, :488)
searched: unmatched|waitingForNhi|stub|nhiPending|approvalNumber in src -> only 'unmatched appointment' manualIntervention parking at integrationActions.ts:17,284 (unrelated to NHI)
items.demo_trigger: Button 'Receive booking without NHI' on the Integration monitor (Surgeon PDF inbox and feed replay): feeds a row with a blank NHI so it lands on the unmatched queue and a stub appears on its List; then the office types the NHI on the queue row and it becomes a Booking on the List.
items.verify_note: Confirmed no unmatched queue or stub exists (searched with several vocabularies); the only 'unmatched' hits are about appointment/target-list mismatches. NHI-less Booking creation is real in the manual form and the PDF ingest. Status is Verify (OQ-118 answered by Donald only), but the grade follows the text as written. Sensible to build jointly with EP-02 (US-02.1.4, FT-02.6).
items.title: Patient without NHI

items.summary: No waiting-for-NHI view, no chase address, no urgent marking and no List stub; worse, a no-NHI row is saved as a provisional Patient and Booking, the opposite of 'no Booking and no patient record exists for such a row'.
items.requirement_says: An incoming booking with no NHI waits on the unmatched queue and shows as a stub on its List; the office's waiting view shows patient as received, List or date, the one address to chase (List sender, else the surgeon's first office contact), marks rows urgent as the List date nears; adding the NHI matches the row to the patient's single record and makes it a Booking, never a duplicate.
items.prototype_does: upsertPatient creates a provisional Patient with no nhi (outcome createdProvisional) and createBooking/ingestPdfRow put a Booking on the List showing 'NHI pending'. A malformed NHI refuses or dead-letters; a blank one is accepted. No unmatched queue, no stub, no chase address.

No address to chase (List's sender address, else the surgeon's first office contact) and no request-an-NHI action; no sender address is held on a List and the surgeon's office contacts (US-13.6.5) are not modelled
No 'one address only' rule or choice of other contacts to switch to
No urgent marking as the List date nears
No stub on the List for a waiting row, for anaesthetist or office (Phase 33a, US-02.6.1)
No add-NHI step that matches the row to the single record and converts it to a Booking
evidence: searched: unmatched|waitingForNhi|waiting for nhi|chase|importRow|stub in aa-prototype/src -> only store/integrationActions.ts:17,341 comments about manualIntervention
items.demo_trigger: Button 'Row arrives with no NHI' on the Admin intake/Matching screen (once it exists): stages a hospital-download or surgeon-PDF row with no NHI so it shows as waiting, with the chase address and a stub on its List. Button 'Add the NHI' on that row; the demo clock shortcuts (Next day, +7 days) show it turning urgent as the List date nears.
items.verify_note: Re-searched for any unmatched, waiting, chase, stub or importRow code: none beyond comments. Confirmed intake.ts still builds a provisional Patient and the seed carries a provisional no-NHI Booking. Added the missing 'one address only / other contacts offered' rule. Contradicts upheld (older reading of OQ-49 still implemented). Size L is right given dependence on Phase 33/33a/40 and a new contact concept.
items.title: Intake rows waiting for an NHI

items.summary: A Procedure whose Contract does not bill its holder bills its payer (the patient by default): No contract RVG, an anaesthetist's own Contract, a surgeon's fixed price, No contract Fixed price and every prepaid Contract; the Booking's funder never decides.
items.requirement_says: When a Procedure's Contract does not bill its holder, its payer (the patient unless changed) is billed, for No contract RVG, an anaesthetist's own Contract, a surgeon's fixed-price Contract, No contract Fixed price, every prepaid Contract, and insured patients who claim back themselves.
items.prototype_does: billablePartyForProcedure returns the payer for any Contract whose billsTo is not 'holder'; billsPayerOnly forces payer billing for AA/anaesthetist holders and prepaid Contracts; seeded No contract RVG and the surgeon fixed-price Contract (doyleBariatric) are billsTo payer; the funder is never an input.
items.verify_note: Re-read whoIsBilled.ts, billsPayerOnly and the seeded Contracts; all three acceptance criteria hold (patient billed under No contract RVG; surgeon fixed price bills payer at the Contract price; an insured patient under No contract RVG is billed, not the insurer). Nothing contradicts.
items.title: Patient billed when the Contract does not bill its holder

items.summary: The per-Procedure payer, tick, offer to other Procedures, copy rule, holder-billed hiding and 'Payer: not billed yet' are all built; what remains is one stale Booking-level payer block on the add-Booking form whose hint points at a 'Booking's Payer row' that no longer exists.
items.requirement_says: Each Procedure holds a payer filled from the patient and editable to a guardian or other party; changing it offers the same change on the other Procedures billing the same payer (ticked, never forced); a later Procedure copies the shared payer else starts from the patient; a holder-billed Procedure never invoices its payer; the Paid by line shows name, relationship and warnings only where the Contract bills the payer, 'not billed yet' before a Contract; there is no separate payer section for the Booking as a whole.
items.prototype_does: Procedure.payer is patient or an 'other' payer (BP####). PaidBySheet opens from the Paid by line with the 'different payer' tick, the ticked-by-default offer (labelled provisional, OQ-140) and saves through setProcedurePayer. payerForNewProcedure applies on addProcedure and addendum. PaidByRow shows payer and relationship only where the Contract bills the payer and 'Payer: not billed yet' with no Contract; BookingDetailBody has no Booking-level payer section. ManualBookingForm still shows a 'Payer' block (patient or different payer) at Booking creation, applied to the new Booking's one Procedure, and its hint reads 'add one on the Booking's Payer row'.
missing_or_wrong: Stale copy: ManualBookingForm.tsx:323 tells the user to add the email or address 'on the Booking's Payer row', but the payer is now in each Procedure's Paid by line (no Booking-level payer row exists); the add form's separate 'Payer' block reads as a Booking-level payer section
evidence: aa-prototype/src/store/bookingActions.ts:130-180 (form payer goes to the new Booking's Procedure)
aa-prototype/src/shared/booking/PaidByRow.tsx:55-130; aa-prototype/src/shared/booking/BillingCard.tsx:158-177 (payer shown only where invoiced kind is patient or payer)
items.demo_trigger: Existing: seeded Grace Park (Hana Park payer on two Procedures) shows the offer and the guardian; no extra trigger needed.
items.verify_note: Re-opened PaidBySheet, PaidByRow, procedurePayer.ts, bookingActions and BookingDetailBody: every acceptance criterion holds and the Booking detail has no payer section. Found the add-Booking form still carries a Booking-level 'Payer' block with copy pointing at a 'Booking's Payer row' that Phase 22a removed, contradicting the story's 'no separate payer section for the Booking as a whole'. A one-line copy fix at most (the block itself maps onto the first Procedure), so Partial at size S rather than Matches. Screenshots captioned with the per-Booking payer are a recapture item, not code.
items.title: Payer on each Procedure, editable to a guardian

items.summary: A payer-billed Procedure whose payer has neither email nor an NZ Post postal address shows 'Email or postal address needed'; the sheet asks but still saves; postal alone is enough; holder-billed Procedures are never asked; Review flags it per Procedure.
items.requirement_says: For each Procedure billed to its payer, the payer needs an email or an NZ Post standard postal address and the system asks for one; postal-only is accepted; a holder-billed Procedure is never asked; with two Procedures only the payer-billed one shows the request.
items.prototype_does: payerContactMissing is per Procedure and false for a holder-billed or contract-less Procedure; payerHasContact accepts email or a valid postal address (line, city, 4-digit postcode); PaidByRow shows the pill; PaidBySheet shows PAYER_CONTACT_ASK and saves; reviewFlags raises a neutral payerContactMissing flag; invoiceDeliveryFor posts when no email.
items.demo_trigger: Existing: seeded Kevin Doherty (no email or address) on the payer-review List; Review flag in Admin Review.
items.verify_note: Checked all four acceptance criteria against payerContactMissing, isValidPostalAddress, the Paid by pill and the sheet; all hold. Edge noted only: a split Procedure asks of every person-billed share even under a holder Contract, which the story does not address. OQ-122 only affects how post is produced (labelled provisional).
items.title: Payer email or postal address required when the payer is billed

items.summary: A mild, never-blocking warning per Procedure when a patient under 18 is left as payer on a payer-billed Procedure, 'Under 18' on each Paid by line, one folded to-do row per Booking that Clear clears; none when a parent pays or a holder is billed.
items.requirement_says: A patient under 18 left as payer on a Procedure billed to its payer raises a mild warning to staff that never blocks; it shows as 'Under 18' on each such Procedure's Paid by line, the to-do list holds one per Booking, an admin can clear it; none when someone else pays or a holder is billed.
items.prototype_does: childPayerOn per Procedure (patient under 18 on the List date, payer is the patient, Contract bills payer, or a split share to the patient); childPayerRule emits one mild before-procedure finding per Procedure; PaidByRow shows the 'Under 18' pill; WarningsToDo folds a Booking's child rows to one and Clear clears every folded key; the anaesthetist sees it on the Booking.
items.demo_trigger: Existing: 'Raise sample warnings' / 'Clear sample warnings'; seeded Grace Park and Ella Moana (15, patient pays).
items.verify_note: Re-read the rule, childPayerOn, the Paid by pill and the to-do fold and clear; all four acceptance criteria satisfied. Edge only: a split with a patient share returns true without checking the Contract bills the payer, not contradicted by the criteria.
items.title: Warn when a child is the payer on a Procedure

BillingMonitorScreen shows per-card status pills (Invoiced, Part paid, Paid) with patient name and a 'Prior balance' tag. Billing mirror holds invoice totals and receivedAmount per case (caseOutstandingAmount).

No per-patient invoice list across anaesthetists
Paid/part paid/unpaid per invoice is not shown in the invoice list (it is per card in the Billing monitor, not per patient)
No patient search by name/NHI in admin

items.title: Patient outstanding bills view

items.summary: Only a bare 'Prior balance' pill in the Admin Billing monitor exists; there is no alert on creating or matching a Booking, no mild or strong by invoice age (90 days), no credit-balance alert, no to-do entry and no colour code on the anaesthetist's List.

Not tied to Booking creation or matching, no age or strength, ignores credits, not a registered warning rule (five rules), not visible to the anaesthetist or to-do list; its own tooltip says open versus overdue is not distinguished (no due date on invoices).

No mild vs strong: no 90-day threshold from the invoice date, no age logic, no fixed threshold setting
No credit-balance (+) mild alert and no credit concept in the billing mirror

Pill shows only in the Billing monitor on already-authorised Lists, not where staff create or open a Booking
Not shown beside the prepayment alert on the Booking

The clock shortcuts age the invoice past 90 days.

items.summary: A shared free-text note on the Booking exists and is seen by the next reader (the one acceptance criterion), but there is no List note by anyone, no recorded follow-up actions and no invoice re-send.
items.requirement_says: Admins can record follow-up actions and re-send invoices for outstanding items; anyone, office or anaesthetist, can write a free-text note on a List or Booking that everyone opening it sees.

MISSING: re-send an invoice (second send refused) and a log of follow-up actions for outstanding items

items.verify_note: Checked note editing and List.notes usage and emailInvoice guards. Partial confirmed since the story's headline (follow-up actions, re-send, List note) is missing even though its single acceptance criterion is met.
items.title: Follow-up tools

items.summary: Insurer or funder Party and approval number on the Booking, editable by office and by the anaesthetist on the day, the mild never-blocking missing-number warning for insurers only, and no completion block are all built; the insurer and number do not yet show on a matching screen when a booking comes in.

No hospital-download or PDF row sets the funder or approval number and no matching screen exists to show them.
missing_or_wrong: Insurer and approval number do not show on a matching screen as the booking comes in: no Matching screen (Phase 33) and intake paths (hospital download rows, surgeon PDF) do not carry funderPartyId or insuranceApprovalNumber
OQ-142 open: approval number not printed on the holder's invoice and no ACC claim number field (undecided; not a gap yet)
evidence: aa-prototype/src/store/insuranceActions.ts:35-80 setBookingInsurance (header comment: 'Phase 33 sets both from a hospital download row')
searched: funderPartyId|insuranceApprovalNumber in store/integrationActions.ts and domain/integrations -> none

But the story body states the insurer and number 'show on the matching screen when the booking comes in', which no code does and the reviewer listed as a missing point while still grading Matches. items.title: Insurance and approval number on the Booking

items.summary: The prototype has a rich HL7 v2/FHIR R4 simulation with store-then-process, retry, dead letter, manual intervention and a simulated NHI lookup, and it badges the HL7/FHIR tabs as Future scope; but the first-release shape the epic now states (hospital files imported into a manual matching screen, no automatic sync) does not exist, so automatic message application is the only hospital intake there is.
items.requirement_says: HL7 v2 and FHIR R4 integration and the national identity services are mostly after the first release: the first release keeps a manual matching review with St George's and Southern Cross files imported into the matching screen and no automatic sync, while the NHI lookup (a simple API) is in scope for the first release; the future integration tier is an adapter over a durable queue with retries, quiet-feed alerting and a manual intervention path.
items.prototype_does: The Admin Integrations monitor (/admin/integrations) shows a store-then-process message log with Reprocess, editable per-feed field mappings, surgeon PDFs, a data-quality queue and validators. The Messages and Feed config tabs carry a Future-scope DemoBadge and a note that 'In scope today is the St George's and Southern Cross download into a matching screen'. Demo triggers fire-hospital-message and replay-hospital-message apply canned HL7 v2/FHIR messages straight to Souter's Lists with no matching review. /demo/integrations shows source and effect panes and a FHIR-first target callout. Retry is a fixed 900ms timer with MAX_ATTEMPTS 3, then deadLetter; there is no exponential backoff. NHI lookup (lookupNhi, canned patients) is on the manual booking form, badged as a simulated Digital Services Hub call. No matching screen exists; code comments say it is 'Interim until Phase 33'.
missing_or_wrong: No matching screen and no 'import hospital file' flow for St George's and Southern Cross (the epic's stated first-release intake, FT-02.1 and US-02.1.2); hospital rows are applied straight to Lists by processMessage, so the only hospital intake shown is the automatic-sync one OQ-109 says is not in the first release

The three seeded feeds (FEED-STG HL7, FEED-CPH HL7, FEED-SX FHIR) and the canned messages do not model the file-import posture: the Christchurch Public feed is shown as live, and nothing is imported as a file
No alert when a hospital feed goes quiet (FT-14.5): integrationAttentionCount only counts deadLetter and manualIntervention
Retry is a fixed-interval timer, not exponential backoff (FT-14.5)
No visible transport-adapter or per-hospital configuration matrix (v2/FHIR, polled/pushed), and no durable-queue depiction beyond the message log

DemoIntegrations callout still describes the messages as arriving as SFTP batches with a near-real-time target, and the Admin intro text presents translation to FHIR and retry as the working design, rather than the file import now in scope

NHI lookup is in scope for the first release and works against canned patients only, with no unreachable-API or not-found handling beyond found:false; HPI CPN and NZHIS validators exist and are adequate for a demo

aa-prototype/src/store/selectors.ts:1522-1526 (integrationAttentionCount: dead letter and manual intervention only)

summary_md:
### Headline

The prototype is the July RFP model with Phases 15 to 32 layered on. Calendar, Slots, Lists, Draft Lists, pairings, tiers, warnings engine, the AA fee run and the Xero simulation are close to the catalogue. Money and intake are not. Of roughly 235 graded items, about 40 Match, about 25 are Partial, about 15 are Missing, and the rest are Contradicts or Grouping. Contradicts dominates EP-02 to EP-08, EP-11 and EP-12: the prototype implements a different, superseded design there, not a smaller version of the new one. EP-01, EP-10 and most of EP-13 are near done. The core is one coordinated rework: Contract (holder, dated versions, lines, flags) replaces billing route plus Type 1/2/3. Pricing, completion, prepayment, invoicing, payer, review and events all hang off it. Statuses were not used to scope work; they appear below only where an open question (OQ) makes a gap unsafe.

### Themes

**1. Contract-centred billing (XL).** Billing route, optional governing Contract, Type 1/2/3 and protected default Type 1s go. In: holders with an is-billed flag, dated Contract versions with AA code, standalone lines, one AA-held No contract (RVG), mandatory Contract per Procedure, staged review and submit, authorisation snapshot, filtered picker, anaesthetist may change Contract until AUTHORISED. Items: EP-04, FT-04.1 to 04.3, US-04.1.1 to 04.1.6, US-04.2.x, US-04.3.x, FT-03.4, US-03.4.1, US-08.1.1, US-07.3.1. DM-07, DM-09, DM-10, DM-48, DM-49, DM-57, DM-08, DM-16. RV-06, RV-11, RV-18, RV-32. Split into model and maths, versioning and staging screens, picker and booking setup.

**2. Pricing, units and modifiers (XL).** Price, rate and discount become values on the Procedure; no mandatory reason; Contract flag gates the anaesthetist; $0 gives a no-charge invoice; discount is its own invoice line; modifier units split above four; RVG becomes a hidden-key master (NZSA 2021, duplicate codes); modifiers become records with explanations, age pre-applied, ASA ordinary; out-of-range warns instead of blocking; completion rules reworked ("finish", not "handover"). Items: FT-05.1 to 05.4, US-05.x, FT-03.3, FT-03.5, US-03.3.x, US-03.5.x, US-03.6.1. DM-13, DM-43, DM-44, DM-50, DM-14, DM-15, DM-46. RV-03, RV-04, RV-07 to RV-10, RV-21, RV-22, RV-38. Many S quick wins (NHI, wording, reason removal, make-primary).

**3. Hospital intake matching screen (XL).** Nothing exists: HL7/FHIR and PDF rows apply straight to Bookings. Needed: staged rows, match/create/Draft List/assign/reject, per-row change type, field differences for approval, unmatched queue, day move as cancel plus new, edits allowed until AUTHORISED, third feed (CPH) out of scope. Items: EP-02, FT-02.1, FT-02.5, US-02.1.1/2/4/5, US-02.5.7, US-02.3.1, EP-14 (boundary). DM-34, DM-51. RV-12 to RV-16.

**4. NHI mandatory and source text (M, tied to 3).** Remove provisional patients and "NHI pending"; waiting-for-NHI queue with urgency; text exactly as received per source plus a separate invoice description. Items: US-11.1.1, US-11.1.4, US-11.1.5, US-03.1.5, US-03.1.9, US-08.4.6. DM-30, DM-51. RV-20.

**5. Prepayment and holding account (XL).** Trigger is a prepaid Contract, amount is the line price, admin approval plus letter, payable to a holding account, second pair at authorise, refund on cancel, no automatic balance. Today the anaesthetist is paid before the procedure. Items: EP-06, FT-06.2 to 06.5, US-06.x, FT-08.1, FT-08.3, US-08.2.2, US-08.3.1, FT-09.1, US-09.1.1, US-09.1.3. DM-20, DM-21, DM-22. RV-05, RV-24.

**6. Events, additional invoices, credit notes (XL).** Post-op addendum Booking is replaced by events on the Procedure, additional free-form invoices, credit-in-full-then-rebill, negative payables netted in a weekly cycle. Items: FT-03.7, US-03.7.x, US-05.5.2, FT-08.6, US-08.6.1 to 08.6.5, US-10.2.6. DM-17, DM-18, DM-24, DM-25. RV-23.

**7. Edit window and anaesthetist views (M).** Anaesthetist edits stay open on SUBMITTED; a List leaves the main view at AUTHORISED (not billed); balances show invoices immediately; search by name/NHI/date; scroll back. Items: EP-07, FT-07.2, FT-07.4, US-07.2.1, US-07.2.3, US-07.4.1, US-07.4.2, US-03.1.6, US-03.1.7. DM-55. RV-19.

**8. OQ-81 reversal (M to L).** Unavailability is never a conflict; closed sessions not assignable by the office; sickness takes return-or-assign to a Draft List. Items: US-01.5.2, US-01.5.4, US-01.6.3, US-01.5.5, US-01.4.1. DM-56. RV-25.

**9. ### Structural first

Screen work built before these lands is rebuilt twice. Suggested order:

1. DM-13 (RVG group, hidden key), DM-48 (holders), then DM-07, DM-09, DM-49 (Contract versions, lines, No contract) in one step with DM-46 (remove BillingLine). Then DM-10 (Procedure picks Contract and line), which unblocks DM-43, DM-44, DM-50, DM-14, DM-15, DM-08 and DM-11.
2. DM-22 (internal ledger with its own payable) before DM-21 (holding account) and DM-20 (prepaid trigger); DM-17 (events) before DM-18, DM-24, then DM-25.
3. DM-30 (NHI required) and DM-51 (source text) before DM-34 (matching rows).
4. DM-57 (staged Contract changes) after DM-07 and DM-09.
5. Independent, can run any time: DM-55, DM-56, DM-42, DM-41, DM-32, DM-12. DM-29 follows DM-22. DM-45 is a policy note, fold into DM-07 or DM-24.

Every seed or type change needs a PERSIST_VERSION bump, canvas-golden and seed tests refreshed. About 26 non-test files read governingContractId or billingRoute, so DM-10 is the widest change.

### Remove or rework (reverse check)

- Remove: attachments on Bookings and Lists (RV-01, M); GST period (RV-02, S); rate x time billing and Method 3 flag (RV-03, M; keep fixed ancillary lines until events exist); ACC "should not bill patient" review flag (RV-37, S).
- Rework (large): prepayment category and split (RV-05), default Type 1 fallback (RV-06), billing-time re-resolution (RV-11), route plus Type model (RV-18), prepaid pair paying anaesthetist (RV-24), addendum Booking (RV-23), HL7 auto-apply and third feed (RV-16).
- Rework (small to medium): price reason and flag (RV-04), ordinal pricing (RV-07), modifier split (RV-08), P1 absorption (RV-09), range hard bound (RV-10), completion rules (RV-21), ASA seeding (RV-22), unavailability conflict (RV-25), notice caption and OQ-84 hint (RV-26), office write-through with no Save (RV-28), per-Procedure payer (RV-30), line-level funder split (RV-31), in-place Contract edits (RV-32), GST receipts (RV-33), ageing buckets (RV-35), prior-balance pill (RV-36), modifier master values (RV-38).
- Hide from demo: Surgeon PDF tab (RV-12, no Future badge), automated change behaviours (RV-13), Productivity and Leave panels (RV-34).
- Keep as scaffold: reliability tooling residue (RV-15), photo capture (RV-17).
- Owner questions, not defects: office single-Booking move targets (RV-27); anaesthetist seeing no price (RV-29, Donald's own 28 Sept decision, conflicts with US-03.1.2 and FT-03.5).

### Demo impact

- S1: Beat 1 (Fire hospital message creates the Booking, "arrives in a later build") rewrites around the matching screen. Beat 3 capture changes: optional numeric RVG codes, no ASA seeding, modifier explanations, "finish" wording, Contract line on screen.
- S2: Beats 1b, 3 and 3a (sickness conflict, assign to closed session) change with OQ-81. Phone-advice beat needs the optional "as given" text and mandatory NHI. Beat 3c (own move) gains single-Booking move. Beat 4 and "submit sheet" copy change with the until-AUTHORISED edit rule; review screen content changes. Notification beat loses busy-morning paging.
- S3: billing Beats 1 to 2 (payer/route wording, pair), split-billing and two-funder beats, payables beat if the prepay payable moves to the holding account, GST and balances messaging (invoices now immediate).
- S4: Beat 1 (prepayment warning, Annette Riley), Beat 2 (post-op addendum, explicitly interim), billing failure and retry (relies on default fallback and un-end-dating), dead-letter and feed-mapping beats (CPH feed).
- Compliance tour: Contract effective-dating beat (edit in place becomes a new dated version), ASA edit seeding units, Master data Contracts click paths. Cheat sheet lines on "default Type 1", billing route, "office-only edits" after submit, and "Prior balance" also need edits.
- Unchanged: FT-02.4 ad hoc add (bar NHI), S2 own-move line "nothing recalculated", most fee-run beats.

### Demo-trigger buttons

The product owner's pattern: screen-contextual buttons in the top control area. Roughly 55 items name a trigger; about half already exist and need repointing (Simulate sickness, Fire hospital message, Stage post-op scenario, Authorise List, Raise sample warnings, month-end fee run). About 25 need genuinely new buttons. Clusters:

- Intake: "Receive tomorrow's theatre list" (St George's, Southern Cross), "Receive a changed list", "Receive list with a missing NHI" on the matching screen (FT-02.1, FT-02.5, US-02.1.1/2/4/5, US-11.1.4, US-11.1.5).
- Prepay and ledger: "Prepay holding account" card, "Approve and send" with letter template, "Mark procedure done", "Email patient: anaesthetist changed", cancel-refund (FT-06.4, FT-06.5, US-06.3.1, US-06.3.6, US-06.5.x, FT-08.3).
- Credits and events: "Run next billing run", "Credit and rebill", "Stage double payment", seeded events list (FT-08.6, US-08.6.2, US-03.7.3).
- Contracts: "Stage a price review" creating a future-dated version, then advance the clock (US-04.2.10).
- Stand-ins for colleagues or office: "Ask Dr X to make this session available" (US-01.6.3), "Office resolves alert" (US-03.6.3), "Colleague moves one of my Bookings" (US-01.4.7), "ACCPAY paid in Xero" (US-09.2.4).
- Warnings and balances: new samples for child payer, insurer with no Contract, balance (mild, strong, credit), out-of-range base units (US-13.7.1, US-11.3.2, US-03.3.1).
- Platform: "Load full-scale dataset", "Run NHI leak scan", "Run cutover data load", "Skip sign-in", approve-week's-BCTIs (US-15.0.4, US-15.0.6, US-13.4.3, US-13.5.3, US-10.2.6).
- No trigger needed: EP-05 pricing (seed scenarios instead: 3-procedure 7-unit Booking, discount Contract, flag-off Contract, $0 Booking).

### Uncertainty

Unsafe to build fully until answered:

- OQ-95 (modifier application, age bands): US-03.3.4, US-03.3.8, US-05.1.4, US-05.1.5, RV-22, RV-38. Build age and ASA changes as labelled simplifications.
- OQ-101 (RVG ranges, system code), OQ-102 (tier names), OQ-113 (colleague ordering): US-05.1.1, US-03.3.1, US-01.3.6, US-01.4.5.
- OQ-105, OQ-106, OQ-93, OQ-98, OQ-114, OQ-99 (surgeon arrangements, insurance filtering, flag purpose): US-04.1.5, US-04.2.1, US-04.3.2, US-04.3.3, FT-11.4, US-11.4.1. These gate the picker and who-is-billed, so DM-48 and DM-10 have a soft edge here.
- OQ-96, OQ-97, OQ-104, OQ-116 (prepaid price edits, part credit, price held on issued invoice, mixed Bookings), OQ-115 (refund route): EP-06 detail, FT-06.4, US-06.5.2, US-08.6.2. Build assumptions in the catalogue.
- OQ-100 (data load, upload) and OQ-103 (invoice description for RVG Contract): US-04.1.6, US-13.4.3, US-08.4.6.
- OQ-109 and OQ-13 (hospital feeds, formats): the matching screen's row shape, US-02.1.1, US-02.1.5. Build against canned rows.
- OQ-111, OQ-47, OQ-112, OQ-29, OQ-60, OQ-12: payables detection (US-09.2.4, hold), weekly cycle (US-10.2.6, US-10.2.7), fee run label, BCTI wording (US-09.1.4 placeholder only), ACC pre-op codes (US-05.5.2).
- OQ-85 and OQ-83: single-Booking move edges, sign-in (keep skippable).
- Catalogue inconsistencies to raise with the owner, not build around: US-01.5.4 AC "reassign clears a hospital-closure conflict"; US-03.3.4 locked versus US-05.1.4 not locked; US-15.0.1 "no Contract complexity" versus US-03.1.2; US-07.4.1 screenshot caption; US-04.2.10 relink versus authorisation lock.

dataModelDeltas.title: Explicit-save change sets, an on-demand update email draft picked from the change history and addressed to the List's sender or the surgeon's first office contact, and email templates

dataModelDeltas.title: A session may be split into an A and a B List, one surgeon each (Proposed): the one List per Slot rule gains its first exception
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: An admin can split an anaesthetist's AM or PM session into an A and a B List when two surgeons share it, each with its own surgeon, two at most (US-01.1.5, Proposed, not agreed by AA).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: A Slot holds at most one List by construction (List.slotId, no list on the Slot); answeringLists keeps one answering List per day and session; out-of-hours adds a session but keeps one List per Slot. No A or B label.

If agreed, Slot to List becomes one to one-or-two with an A or B label; grid, generation, recurring painting, move paths, conflicts, colleague finder and the out-of-hours Slot all assume one List per session (about 50 non-test files read Session). Independent of the pricing track.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Upheld (US-01.1.5 status 1, Proposed; the domain model says that rule stands until agreed). File count corrected from 65 to about 50 (grep -w Session over non-test files).

dataModelDeltas.title: The anaesthetist profile holds mandatory bank account details and a mandatory HPI CPN (the rest of the master data is built)
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: The anaesthetist profile holds contact details, registration number, HPI CPN, bank account details held in the system and the dollar value per unit; no GST period. Bank details and the anaesthetist's HPI CPN are mandatory. A surgeon's HPI CPN may be blank until known (DM-60).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Anaesthetist holds contact, unit value, GST period, an HPI CPN accepted blank (types.ts:296 to :301 comment: optional on an anaesthetist), and the optional Admin-only gstNumber. No bank details.
dataModelDeltas.impact: One bank-account field set on Anaesthetist, a required-field guard on the HPI CPN and bank details in the form and store action, seed values. Master data only: payment is made in Xero (DM-25). Low risk, any time.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: hpiId typed string with blank allowed; no bank fields on Anaesthetist.

dataModelDeltas.title: Reference data: a master public-holiday calendar and a repeatable one-off data load (the maintenance screens for the new masters are built)
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Admins maintain all reference data in one place (hospitals, surgeons with specialties and contacts, groups, anaesthetists, Slot statuses, recurring bookings, master and per-hospital holidays, RVG groups, modifiers, specialties, funding tags, Parties, Contracts); a one-off load seeds the system at cutover with surgeons and practice names, no HPI CPN required.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Master Data CRUD exists for hospitals, anaesthetists, surgeons, rooms (which DM-60 removes), statuses, recurring bookings, holidays, Parties, Contracts with ranges, specialties, funding tags, RVG groups and modifiers. Missing: holidays are per hospital only (HospitalHoliday, no master calendar); seed data are TypeScript fixtures with no repeatable load.
dataModelDeltas.impact: A master public-holiday calendar feeding each hospital's, an editor for the RVG time rule (Phase 42), optionally a repeatable load script for seeds.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: US-13.4.1 names the master (public holiday) calendar explicitly.

dataModelDeltas.title: Warning routine: the model, the dashboard to-do list and five rules are built; only the balance rule remains
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: One routine raises mild or strong warnings that never block: unpaid prepayment, a billable patient with a balance, a child left as a Procedure's payer (per Procedure, one to-do per Booking), base units outside the RVG range, an insured Booking with no approval number. The prepayment and balance alerts are separate rules shown side by side (OQ-134).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Warning, WarningRule and WarningClearance with five rules (prepaymentUnpaid, baseUnitsOutsideGuide, childPayer, approvalNumberMissing, splitDoesNotFit; the last is a prototype extra, the catalogue list being examples), stored office clearance, dashboard to-do list and Booking flag in both apps. childPayer emits one finding per Procedure with a per-Booking dashboard fold (Phase 22a). No balance rule.
dataModelDeltas.impact: One rule left: the billable-patient-with-a-balance rule, a second rule beside prepaymentUnpaid, reading DM-23's derived balance. Needs DM-23. The child-payer per-Procedure finding that this delta carried is built.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: rules/ directory holds exactly the five rules named; no balance rule.

dataModelDeltas.title: Surgeons: no room record, a practice name as text, one personal and one or more office contacts on the surgeon, and an HPI CPN that can be blank until known
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: 18 November (Donald, for the build, not yet seen by AA; OQ-127 answered, OQ-128 superseded, US-13.6.1 Retired): the system keeps no surgeons' room record. The surgeon profile holds the practice name as plain text, one personal contact and one or more office contacts (name, email, phone each, blanks allowed) with an always-one-shown plus and minus form; HPI CPN filled in by admin and may be blank until known, unique when held (OQ-129); the master list is AA's address book of people only; the cutover load takes surgeons with practice names and no HPI CPN.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Phases 17 and 17a built the opposite: SurgeonRoom master with optional email, phone and RoomContact list; Surgeon.roomIds an ordered list of rooms; Surgeon.hpiId required, unique and refused blank. No practice name text, personal contact or office contacts on the surgeon. 20 non-test files read the room symbols (roomContacts.ts, surgeons.ts, roomContactActions.ts, surgeonActions.ts, admin room and contact sheets); the directory seed loads 40 rooms and 131 surgeons with invented HPI CPNs.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Unwind 17a: remove SurgeonRoom, RoomContact and Surgeon.roomIds with their screens and actions; add Surgeon.practiceName, personalContact and officeContacts with the plus and minus form; make hpiId optional (unique when held) and drop the invented directory numbers; reseed the directory; PERSIST bump; recapture screenshots that describe rooms. Precedes DM-35's To rule, DM-30 and DM-58's chase address and DM-70. Independent of money and pricing.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Upheld: types.ts:362 to :410 read directly (roomIds, required hpiId, SurgeonRoom, RoomContact); US-13.6.1 status 6 Retired, US-13.6.2 and US-13.6.5 at Verify. File count corrected from 19 to 20.

dataModelDeltas.title: The Procedure's hospital contract or approval reference and its completeness prompt are removed: a Contract asks the Booking for no references (settled 18 November)
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: OQ-136 answered 18 November (Donald, option 1): no number other than the insurer approval number; a Contract does not ask the Booking for references; the holder's own code is the Contract's holder reference code; a Contract setting can be added later if a holder needs one. Whether the approval number prints on the holder's invoice and whether an ACC claim number is held are OQ-142.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Procedure.billingReference (16 non-test files), billingReferenceMissing read by the office billing setup prompt, the holder layout's cross-match hospital reference (Invoice.crossMatch.hospitalRef, types.ts:1376), and the Phase 25 BookingLock copying it per Procedure. The review flag for it was already dropped.
