dataModelDeltas.verify_note: OQ-136 answer read in full; US-08.4.1 describes cross-match fields without naming a Booking reference, and the domain model's 'references the holder needs' row is explicit.

dataModelDeltas.title: Contract change consequences: a warning listing Procedures still on an old Contract, a warning listing authorised Procedures a backdated range left at their old price, and a review flag on a Disabled Contract
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: New 18 November (OQ-133, OQ-135, Donald for the build): making a new Contract for a dated change, or disabling the old one, warns and lists Procedures dated on or after the change still on the old Contract, nothing moves by itself (US-04.1.2); a backdated price range warns with a count and list of authorised Procedures that kept their old price and lists no re-priced ones (US-04.2.15); a review flag, never a block, on a not-yet-authorised Procedure dated on or after the day its Contract was disabled, read from the Contract audit (US-07.2.2).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Phase 25 built the Contract history from the audit (contractHistory.ts) and the pricing snapshot fixing an authorised price (billing.locks), but nothing acts on them: reviewFlags.ts has eight rules (contractChanged, contractNoLongerFits, needsInvoiceDestination, needsPrice, typedPrice, notCompleted, payerContactMissing, btmOverride) and none for a Disabled Contract; creating a Contract takes no 'replaces' Contract or change date; disabling or adding a range lists nothing.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Two pure selectors (Procedures dated on or after a date still on a Contract; authorised Procedures a range covers whose locked price differs), an optional 'replaces Contract and from date' input on creating a Contract (stored or only for the warning, a build choice), two action-time warnings with lists, one review-flag rule keyed on the disable day. Nothing blocks. Free-standing; builds on Phase 25.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: US-04.1.2 acceptance criteria 'Dated change warning' and 'Warned on disable' read; the eight-rule review-flag union read directly.

dataModelDeltas.title: A List keeps where it came from: a surgeon's rooms' PDF with the address it arrived from, the hospital's list, or entry by hand
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: New 18 November (US-02.2.4, LIST_ORIGIN in the domain model): each List records its origin (rooms' PDF with the sender email address, hospital list, or by hand); the office's update emails and missing-NHI requests go back to that address, falling back to the surgeon's first office contact. Which address a List keeps when a later PDF arrives from another, and whether a recurring-booking List records an origin, are build choices.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: No List origin. Only a Draft List has a DraftTrail of how it arose (with RequestSource 'pdf' but no sender address); Booking.source is display-only; ingestPdfRow puts a PDF row on a List without recording the sender; the PDF fixtures name the sending surgeon (fromSurgeon), never a room or an address.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Add List.origin (pdf, hospital or manual, plus sender address for a PDF) on ListBase, set where a List is created or first filled and kept after assignment; seed values; show on the Admin List view. DM-35, DM-30 and DM-58 read it, falling back to DM-60's contacts; pairs with DM-61. PERSIST bump.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Upheld (US-02.2.4 status 3; ListBase has no origin). Corrected the fixture detail: pdfSamples.ts names the sending surgeon, not a room.

dataModelDeltas.title: Public as a Slot status: works like Unavailable, shows "Public" and an optional note, carries no List detail
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: New 18 November (OQ-139, Donald for the build; US-01.2.1, US-01.2.2, US-13.1.1): Public is a Slot status like Unavailable, not open for bookings or cover, set by the anaesthetist or the office, showing 'Public' with an optional short note and no List detail, with its own label and master-data colour; the one-day dashboard shows it the same way.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Three seeded statuses (free, holiday, unavailable; cast.ts:223 to :260); statuses are master data (label, colour, bookable, anaesthetistCanSet) and Slot.note exists, but no Public status is seeded. A separate prototype-only ListKind 'private' | 'public' | 'preop' shares one DisplayKey space with status ids, so a status keyed 'public' would collide; the seed has a public-kind List.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Seed a Public status (not bookable, settable by anaesthetist and office) under a non-colliding key, or retire the prototype-only List kind 'public' and re-target the seeded public List; grid, dashboard day view and colleague finder show 'Public' and its note without List detail and treat it as not open for cover. PERSIST bump. Small, independent.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: US-01.2.1 acceptance criteria (Public with note CPH, office sets it) and the DisplayKey collision comment at types.ts:140 to :144 read directly.

deltaSummary: All 26 open deltas survived adversarial re-reading against the catalogue (status, Retired, and the 19-story Future Work lane checked) and the code; none refuted or dropped, and no new structural delta was found after walking domain-model.md and the seed, store and types shapes. Five corrected on detail: DM-46 (31 non-test files mention BillingLine, not 30), DM-60 (20 files read the room symbols, not 19), DM-65 (about 50 files read Session, not 65), DM-70 (the PDF fixtures name the sending surgeon via fromSurgeon, not a room), DM-23 (adds the anaesthetist's own view of the alert, the day count from invoice date and the mild credit-balance alert, OQ-74). DM-45 kept as a policy note (prototype audits a superset; not structural). Retired or Future items cited (US-03.3.6, 03.3.7, 04.2.4, 04.2.7, 12.1.2, 13.6.1; US-02.1.5, FT-14.6) are boundaries or evidence for removals only. Things deliberately not raised as deltas: legacy Insurer and organisation masters behind CounterpartyRef (documented fold into Party), the extra splitDoesNotFit warning rule (catalogue list is only examples), the named office demo actor (sign-in is a demo choice), the absent prepayment letter template (already in DM-20's impact). Counts unchanged: 26 open (NewEntity 7, ChangedEntity 8, RemovedEntity 2, NewRelationship 2, ChangedRelationship 1, NewLifecycle 1, ChangedLifecycle 1, RuleChange 4; sizes L 7, M 12, S 7). The readable file domain-model-delta.md was updated with the corrected figures and an adversarial-verification paragraph.

reverseFindings.title: GST period is a per-anaesthetist setting and a selector on the report
reverseFindings.explanation: US-12.1.2 is status 6 (Retired 16 October: no GST period on the profile, only a unit rate; the GST report is monthly). The prototype stores gstPeriod (monthly, bi-monthly, six-monthly) on every anaesthetist, asks for it on add and edit, shows it on the record and master view, seeds Dr Whitaker six-monthly, and the web GST report has a three-way period switch defaulting from it. Confirmed in code.
reverseFindings.verify_note: Evidence list widened (record screen, master view, mastersActions). The body of US-12.1.2 still describes the retired behaviour and its screenshots show it; only the Notes line and status record the retirement, so that is a catalogue tidy, not a prototype fact.

reverseFindings.title: Prepayment still carries a split deposit, a netting final invoice, a failing overrun, no approval step and no settlement on cancel
prototype_evidence: aa-prototype/src/domain/billing/invoiceBuild.ts:76-132 split deposit line and 'Pre-payment, estimated full fee'
aa-prototype/src/domain/billing/lock.ts:375 deposit netted off the final invoice; :522 negativeTotal
aa-prototype/src/store/prepaymentActions.ts:45-140 office raise with no approval step; aa-prototype/src/shared/booking/BookingDetailBody.tsx:561
aa-prototype/src/domain/seed/bookings.ts:862 seeded split $800 on $1,200; no prepayment, credit or refund handling in store/lifecycle.ts cancelBooking
reverseFindings.explanation: The trigger is now right (a prepaid Contract billing the payer, Phase 20). What remains is the interim shape the catalogue has overturned: US-06.2.2 says the prepaid amount is always the full amount with no partial prepayment or deposit and is read-only once raised; US-06.3.1 raises it on admin approval (switchable); US-08.2.2 and US-06.4.1 leave a prepaid Procedure off the final invoice with nothing deducted and nothing credited automatically; US-06.5.2 credits an unpaid or refunds a paid prepayment on cancel. The prototype keeps a flat split deposit beside full, words the full amount 'estimated full fee' (US-06.2.3 retired the estimate), lets the office raise it with no approval, nets the deposit off the final invoice, fails a Booking whose prepayment exceeds the fee (US-06.4.2 retired) and settles nothing on cancel. All confirmed in code.
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-04.2.12 removed from the basis: its retired 'full or split' is a fee split between parties (now the typed Paid by action), not a deposit, so the retired-items table row is now Honoured. US-06.2.2 added as the direct contradiction of the deposit. Phase 27 replaces this; Donald's decisions for the build.

reverseFindings.title: The surgeons' rooms master record is built in full
prototype_evidence: aa-prototype/src/store/surgeonActions.ts:52-63,205 roomRequired, hpiCpnRequired, duplicateHpiCpn, createSurgeonRoom; store/roomContactActions.ts; domain/roomContacts.ts
reverseFindings.explanation: US-13.6.1 is status 6 (Retired 18 November, Donald for the build): no room record; contacts live on the surgeon (US-13.6.5: one personal contact plus one or more office contacts), the practice name is plain text and the HPI CPN may be blank until known (US-13.6.2). Phase 17a, finished the day before, built a Surgeons' rooms master, room email and phone, practice manager and PA contacts on the room, a required room per surgeon, a room card on the profile, a required HPI CPN and a directory seeded with room contacts. The 9 October Phase 17 rulings ('One room per surgeon', 'HPI CPN one required hpiId') are overturned with it. Confirmed in code.
reverseFindings.verify_note: HPI CPN uniqueness is still catalogue-backed (US-13.6.2 refuses a duplicate); only 'required' (and the room requirement) is contradicted. The retirement sits at Verify (Donald's decision, not yet seen by AA).

reverseFindings.title: Automated modify, reschedule and cancel from hospital messages is shown working, with a day move applied as a move
prototype_evidence: aa-prototype/src/store/integrationActions.ts:243-265 S13 reassign across Lists (only where the target session already holds a List); :292 S15 cancel; :338-357 locked target parks as manualIntervention
reverseFindings.explanation: All six sit in the Future Work swimlane. The canned S13 to S15 messages are applied by an integration actor with no admin: a cross-List move on S13 contradicts US-02.5.2 (a List never moves day), a submitted List refuses inbound changes where US-02.5.4 accepts them until AUTHORISED, and the S15 cancel settles no prepayment (US-02.5.3, same gap as RV-05). The Messages tab and demo actions already carry the Future badge; the issue is the behaviour shown.
reverseFindings.verify_note: Narrowed: the S13 reschedule parks for the office when the target session has no List (interim until Phase 33), so the cross-List move happens only when a List already exists in the target session.

reverseFindings.title: HL7 v2 to FHIR simulator, live drip, and Scenario S1 built on them

The tabs and demo actions are badged, but the Integrations intro ('translated to FHIR R4 and applied to the schedule') is not, a one-per-second 'Start live feed' remains, and S1 still opens with a pushed message creating a Booking (its text does call it a Future-scope illustration).
reverseFindings.verify_note: Rework S1 around the matching screen (Phase 34).

reverseFindings.title: Reliability tooling (retries, dead-letter queue, manual intervention) with an unbadged nav badge and patient names in the log

The prototype retries three times, dead-letters, shows an amber badge on the Integrations nav item, offers Reprocess, and lists the patient's name on every log row where US-14.5.1 wants a restricted working view with the raw payload behind restricted access. The Messages tab is badged; the nav badge and Patient column are not.

reverseFindings.title: Further hospital feeds and automatic application with no matching step
prototype_evidence: aa-prototype/src/domain/integrations/feeds.ts:8-22 three feeds incl. Christchurch Public and a FHIR-native Southern Cross
aa-prototype/src/store/integrationActions.ts:196-215 createBooking onto the target List (parks only when no List exists)
reverseFindings.explanation: Further feeds and automatic matching are Future Work, and US-02.1.5 (automatic St George's and Southern Cross sync) joined them on 18 November. The first release keeps a manual matching review with an unmatched queue. The prototype writes the Booking straight onto the target List with no review queue, last-synced display or unmatched queue. reverseFindings.title: A patient without an NHI is allowed (provisional record, 'NHI pending')
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes the Phase 03 and 10 provisional-patient rulings. US-11.1.4, US-11.1.1, US-03.1.5 and US-02.1.4 all say the NHI is mandatory, a Booking cannot be saved without one, there is no 'NHI pending' Booking, and a booking without one waits on the unmatched queue with a stub on its List (US-02.6.1, OQ-118 answered 4 November). The prototype takes the NHI as optional, creates a provisional record, shows 'NHI pending' and seeds a no-NHI patient. Confirmed.
reverseFindings.verify_note: Build the stub rather than extend the NHI pending path.

reverseFindings.title: Post-op addendum is a new linked Booking on today's free session
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes the Phase 09 reading. US-03.7.1 makes a post-op event an element attached to the original Procedure with its own date and time (a time or fixed fee, no modifiers); the original Booking stays immutable, events appear on no List and bill in the next run (OQ-121). The prototype creates a second linked Booking on a new List in a free session today that runs a full capture, submit and authorise cycle.
reverseFindings.verify_note: Already self-labelled interim in code; Phase 38b / 39b replace it.

reverseFindings.title: A prepaid invoice gets a full receivable and payable pair that pays the anaesthetist; the catalogue holds it in the AA Holding account
prototype_evidence: AA Holding account named only in comments (store/listMoveActions.ts:163,375,445; slotActions.ts:448; prepaymentActions.ts:56), not in the model, ledger or Xero mirror
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes Phase 09/10 D-pre-invoice-pair. US-06.3.1 creates a receivable from the payer and a payable to the AA Holding account, not to the anaesthetist, on admin approval, and US-06.4.1 moves the money to whoever did the List afterwards by a journal transfer, not a payment. The prototype hands the pre-invoice to Xero as an ordinary pair so a fully-prepaid procedure still has a disbursement path, and has no holding account, no transfer and no cancel refund.
reverseFindings.verify_note: Evidence corrected: the holding account is mentioned in code comments, so 'none anywhere' was too strong; there is no model for it. How Xero posts the move is still open after the 10 November accountant meeting.

reverseFindings.title: The office moves a single Booking to any List on any day
prototype_evidence: aa-prototype/src/apps/admin/flows/MoveBookingFlow.tsx:1-45 target date picker then any List
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes the 2026-07-22 third review; logged as scaffold in Phase 32a. The anaesthetist's move is built to US-01.4.7 (to a colleague free in the Slot, never into an existing List). The office flow still picks any day and any existing List. The catalogue states the move rule for the anaesthetist; US-02.5.2 and OQ-87 describe what arrives from the rooms (a List never moves day), so the day picker is unbacked rather than flatly contradicted.
reverseFindings.verify_note: Softened: FT-01.4 allows a single Booking to move between anaesthetists generally and no story forbids the office doing so; treat as lower confidence, drop the day picker when reworked, and ask the owner about moving into an existing List.

reverseFindings.title: Office edits to a Booking write through on every tap, with no Save
prototype_evidence: aa-prototype/src/apps/admin/screens/AdminBookingDetail.tsx (no Save, Discard or unsaved warning in apps/admin/screens/AdminBookingDetail.tsx or shared/booking)

The Admin Booking detail wraps the same shared body, so every control writes at once. Confirmed by search: no Save, Discard or unsaved text in those files.

reverseFindings.title: The GST report lists customer receipts, not the payments passed to the anaesthetist
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes the Phase 10 GST-activity reading. US-12.2.2 is a monthly list of the payments AA has passed to the anaesthetist with the GST component of each, 'not invoices sent'. The prototype lists receipts on the day the customer pays, before any payout, on mobile and web.
reverseFindings.verify_note: Overlaps RV-02 on the same report; fix together.

reverseFindings.title: The office's 'Run payables' makes the payment to anaesthetists; the catalogue says Xero pays and the system only tracks it
prototype_evidence: aa-prototype/src/apps/admin/screens/BillingMonitorScreen.tsx:129-146 Payables run card and Run payables button (unbadged)
aa-prototype/src/apps/demo/DemoControlPanel.tsx:292,488 S4 step 5 and the note call it the product button
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes the Phase 10 reading that the system disburses. OQ-111 (answered 4 November, Donald for the build): 'Xero is assumed to handle all payments. Our system tracks them'; the ACCPAY is paid in Xero's payables run and the engine records it from a webhook or the poll. The prototype's billing monitor has an unbadged Run payables button that disburses inside the app, the run sheet tells the presenter to press it, and the Xero simulator's Settle invoice also calls disbursePayable.
reverseFindings.verify_note: Added that run-sheet S4 step 5 and the Control Panel note must change with it. Keep the action as a Xero stand-in behind the simulator with the demo badge; the product screen should show detection.

reverseFindings.title: Public is a kind of List with a hospital, surgeon and Bookings; the catalogue makes it a Slot status with no List detail
prototype_evidence: aa-prototype/src/domain/types.ts:128-136 LIST_KINDS and labels include public
aa-prototype/src/domain/seed/recurringBookings.ts:67-124 about a dozen public recurring bookings at CPH; recordedWindow.ts:216
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes the Phase 31 reading 'pre-op and acute Lists name a surgeon' and the original three List kinds. OQ-139 (18 November, Donald for the build): Public is a value in the Slot status list that works like Unavailable, shows 'Public' with an optional note and carries no List detail; AA does not book or bill public work. US-01.2.1 and US-13.1.1 now say the same. The prototype creates Public Lists with Bookings at Christchurch Public and seeds no Public status.
reverseFindings.verify_note: Donald's decision, not yet discussed with AA; reopen if Vanessa says the office uses more.

reverseFindings.title: Dashboard Productivity and Leave panels
reverseFindings.explanation: US-12.2.3 says the dashboard summarises the calendar, the financial position and locum availability; nothing in the catalogue mentions productivity or leave approval. The prototype shows units, lists, fees and a six-month trend, and Leave rows with Approved and Pending pills implying an approval workflow, all seeded for one persona.

reverseFindings.title: Receivables ageing buckets, age chips and an Overdue view
reverseFindings.explanation: US-12.2.1 (OQ-59 accepted): a flat list of unpaid payables, oldest first, with no ageing buckets, no age chips and no Overdue view, each line linking to its Booking. The prototype has ageing bars on the web Dashboard, an Overdue tab with bucket columns, 'view overdue accounts', and an amber age chip on mobile Balances rows.

reverseFindings.title: 'Prior balance' tag has no threshold and sits on the billing monitor after authorisation
reverseFindings.explanation: US-11.3.2 alerts when a Booking is created or matched to a patient with a balance: mild below a 90-day threshold counted from the invoice date, strong above, never blocking, and the anaesthetist sees it on the Booking. The prototype tags any open prior episode with no threshold, only on the billing monitor row (its own tooltip admits it does not distinguish overdue), and shows the anaesthetist nothing. Its only use is that one table.
reverseFindings.verify_note: Partly a gap (no alert at create or match) as well as a misleading tag.

reverseSummary:
Adversarial pass done at HEAD 0fe12f06 against the code and the catalogue files. All 18 findings survive; none dropped and none added. Eight were corrected, and "upheld" below means confirmed in code and against the cited items.

Corrected:
- RV-05: US-04.2.12 removed from the basis. Its retirement is about a fee split between parties, not a deposit, so the retired-items table row for it is now Honoured. US-06.2.2 ("no partial prepayment or deposit") added as the direct contradiction.
- RV-13: narrowed. The S13 cross-List move happens only when the target session already holds a List; otherwise it parks.
- RV-23: notes that the code already marks the action INTERIM until Phase 38b.
- RV-24: the AA Holding account appears in code comments (listMoveActions.ts, slotActions.ts, prepaymentActions.ts), though not in the model, so "none anywhere" was too strong.
- RV-27: softened to lower confidence. FT-01.4 allows a single Booking to move between anaesthetists, and no story forbids the office moving it by hand. The rule in US-02.5.2 and OQ-87 covers what arrives from the rooms.
- RV-40: the S4 run-sheet step 5 and the Control Panel note (DemoControlPanel.tsx:292,488) tell the presenter to press the Run payables button, so they must change with it.
- RV-42: only "HPI CPN required" and "room required" are contradicted. HPI CPN uniqueness is still backed by US-13.6.2. The retirement also overturns the 9 October Phase 17 rulings "One room per surgeon" and "HPI CPN required".
- RV-02: evidence widened to the anaesthetist record, the master view and mastersActions. US-12.1.2's body and screenshots still describe the retired behaviour, which is a catalogue tidy.

Upheld unchanged: RV-14, RV-15, RV-16, RV-20, RV-28, RV-33, RV-34, RV-35, RV-36, RV-43.

Spot checks for retired behaviour that might have been missed found nothing more. The grep terms covered estimated duration, copy booking, attachments, default contracts, insurer flag, hourly rate, adjustment reason, bank details, a Returned state and credit notes. The credit-note and bank-details absences are gaps, not drift.

Updated /Users/d.fraser/Development/Stratos Dev/AnaesthesiaAssociatesRFP/docs/prototype-build/catch-up/analysis/reverse-check.md. It now records the adversarial pass in the header and carries the corrections above in RV-02, RV-05, RV-13, RV-23, RV-24, RV-27, RV-40 and RV-42, and the US-04.2.12 table row.
